```{r so-1}
so_1 <- do.call(rbind, so_1); so_1$cf_vs_cs <- signif(so_1$cf_vs_cs, 2); so_1$cf_vs_fd <- signif(so_1$cf_vs_fd, 2); so_1
```

Every check holds; the largest gap to the central difference is `r format(max(so_1$cf_vs_fd), digits = 2)`
(relative), and to the complex step `r format(max(so_1$cf_vs_cs), digits = 2)`.
**Status: ESTABLISHED** (proof above, verified in four models $\times$ four metrics).

### Result SO2: identification, four statements kept apart {#sec-so-ident}

The four statements are: (1) **local identification** (the rank of $\Delta$), (2) **the relation to the
correlated-first-order model** (the same moment set, or not), (3) **metric equivalence** (the same model on
another latent scale, SO3), (4) **release scope**, which this section does not touch. The third is the
subject of SO3; the second is deliberately not read off the first: equal degrees of freedom and equal fit
(statement 2) do not make the models the same, and neither says anything about identification.

#### SO2.1 Local identification, in production order, at both points of the rank check

**Principle.** $\sigma$ is a rational function of $\theta$ on the region where $(I-B)$ is invertible, here
everywhere, so the rank of $\Delta$ is its generic rank except on a closed null set. Full column rank at *one*
point therefore proves full generic rank, and a model is **locally identified at almost every parameter
value**; a deficiency that holds at every point (a closed-form null direction) proves the opposite. The
production check evaluates the criterion at two points (`dwlsmv_id_rank.mata:90-105`): the starts
$\theta^{(0)}$ and, only if that is deficient, $\theta^{(2)}$, $\theta_k+0.1(\{k\varphi\}-\tfrac12)$ for every
free $\lambda$, $\beta$, $\psi$ at its position $k$ in the full $\theta$; a singular value counts if it
exceeds $10^{-8}$ of the largest (`dwlsmv_numrank.mata:67`). The ratio reported below is the criterion's own
quantity, $\sigma_{\min}/\sigma_{\max}$ of $\Delta$ including the identity threshold block, and the *margin*
is $\log_{10}(\text{ratio}/10^{-8})$. Each model is also run with 1 to 4 thresholds per item and with $G$
last instead of first (8 variants), because $k$ moves with both.

**Result SO2.1.** (i) M3, M4, M5, MT2, MD, M22, M33 (and M2c) are locally identified, at almost every point,
in each of M, U, V, W. (ii) M2, MT1 and M22u are not identified, in any metric, at any point. Proof of (i):
the rank at $\theta^{(2)}$ in the table below; of (ii): the closed-form null directions that follow.

(ii) *M2.* The model's moments depend on $\theta$ through $\Phi_{11},\Phi_{22},\Phi_{12}$ only (three numbers; the
loadings are separate parameters), while $G$ over two has four structural parameters
($b_2,\psi_G,\psi_1,\psi_2$ in M). Explicitly the direction
$(\mathrm db_2,\mathrm d\psi_G,\mathrm d\psi_1,\mathrm d\psi_2)\propto(b_2,\,-\psi_G,\,\psi_G,\,-b_2^2\psi_G)$ leaves
$\Phi_{12}=\psi_Gb_2$, $\Phi_{11}=\psi_G+\psi_1$, $\Phi_{22}=b_2^2\psi_G+\psi_2$ fixed, at every point.
*MT1.* A factor with one item $y_s$ enters the correlations only through $\Phi_{s\cdot}$ with its *other*
factors: $\Phi_{ss}$ multiplies no pair of distinct items. In M and V, $\psi_s$ enters only $\Phi_{ss}$, so
its column of $\Delta$ is identically zero; in U and W, $(\lambda_s,b_s)\mapsto(t\lambda_s,b_s/t)$ leaves every
$\lambda_s\Phi_{s\cdot}$ unchanged. *M22u.* With $\psi_{G_2G_1}=0$ the two blocks of $\Phi_{FF}$ decouple and
each is the M2 argument: deficiency 2.

A model with one $G$ over **two** factors becomes identified by one more restriction (M2c, a second path
fixed at 1: full rank already at $\theta^{(0)}$ in all four metrics), and **two** $G$'s are identified
through their covariance (M22 identified, M22u not). A first-order factor with **two** items is
identified through $G$ (MT2). All verdicts in the table are for production coordinates, in every one of
the 8 variants. (In U and V, M2c reads "$\psi_G=1$ and $b_2=1$"; in M and W "both paths 1".)

```{r so-2-rank}
# ---- SO2: local identification in production coordinates, both points of the rank check
so_specs <- list(
  M2  = list(nk = c(3, 3)),            M2c = list(nk = c(3, 3), fixb = 2L),
  M3  = list(nk = rep(3, 3)),          M4  = list(nk = rep(3, 4)),   M5 = list(nk = rep(3, 5)),
  MT2 = list(nk = c(3, 3, 2)),         MT1 = list(nk = c(3, 3, 1)),
  MD  = list(nk = rep(3, 3), mdi = TRUE),
  M22 = list(nk = rep(3, 4), so_ng = 2, gsplit = c(2, 2)), M33 = list(nk = rep(3, 6), so_ng = 2, gsplit = c(3, 3)),
  M22u = list(nk = rep(3, 4), so_ng = 2, gsplit = c(2, 2), gcov = FALSE))
so_expect <- c(M2 = FALSE, M2c = TRUE, M3 = TRUE, M4 = TRUE, M5 = TRUE, MT2 = TRUE, MT1 = FALSE, MD = TRUE,
               M22 = TRUE, M33 = TRUE, M22u = FALSE)           # identified (passes at some point)?
so_variants <- function(spec, so_mn) {                            # 1 to 4 thresholds per item, G first and G last
  out <- list()
  for (nt in 1:4) for (gl in c(FALSE, TRUE)) {
    so_md <- do.call(so_build, c(spec, list(gm = so_mets[[so_mn]][1], fm = so_mets[[so_mn]][2], nthr = nt, glast = gl)))
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- so_rankcheck(so_md)
  }
  out
}
so_2 <- list()
for (so_nm in names(so_specs)) for (so_mn in names(so_mets)) {
  so_md <- do.call(so_build, c(so_specs[[so_nm]], list(gm = so_mets[[so_mn]][1], fm = so_mets[[so_mn]][2])))
  so_r <- so_rankcheck(so_md); so_v <- so_variants(so_specs[[so_nm]], so_mn)
  so_worst <- min(sapply(so_v, function(so_z) so_z$ratio2)); so_allpass <- all(sapply(so_v, function(so_z) so_z$pass2 || so_z$pass0))
  so_2[[length(so_2) + 1]] <- data.frame(model = so_nm, metric = so_mn, free = so_r$npar, rank0 = so_r$rank0, ratio0 = so_r$ratio0,
    rank2 = so_r$rank2, ratio2 = so_r$ratio2, pass0 = so_r$pass0, pass2 = so_r$pass2, worst_ratio2_8variants = so_worst, passes_all8 = so_allpass,
    margin_dec = log10(so_r$ratio2 / 1e-8))
  so_check(paste("SO2 verdict", so_nm, so_mn), (so_r$pass0 || so_r$pass2) == so_expect[[so_nm]])
  so_check(paste("SO2 verdict in all 8 variants", so_nm, so_mn), so_allpass == so_expect[[so_nm]])
}
so_2 <- do.call(rbind, so_2)
so_2_show <- so_2; for (so_j in c("ratio0", "ratio2", "worst_ratio2_8variants")) so_2_show[[so_j]] <- signif(so_2_show[[so_j]], 2); so_2_show$margin_dec <- round(so_2_show$margin_dec, 1)
so_2_show[, c("model", "metric", "free", "rank0", "rank2", "ratio2", "worst_ratio2_8variants", "margin_dec", "pass2")]
```

M2c's smallest ratio is `r format(min(so_2$ratio0[so_2$model == "M2c"]), digits = 2)`. Narrowest margin among the identified models and over the 8 variants:
`r format(min(so_2$worst_ratio2_8variants[so_2$pass2]), digits = 2)` as a ratio, i.e.
`r round(log10(min(so_2$worst_ratio2_8variants[so_2$pass2]) / 1e-8), 1)` decades above the criterion; in the
default coordinates `r format(min(so_2$ratio2[so_2$pass2]), digits = 2)` (`r so_2$model[so_2$pass2][which.min(so_2$ratio2[so_2$pass2])]`,
metric `r so_2$metric[so_2$pass2][which.min(so_2$ratio2[so_2$pass2])]`). The roadmap's "two orders or more" holds, with 2.7 decades at the narrowest.
The failures are far on the other side: M2, MT1 and M22u have $\sigma_{\min}/\sigma_{\max}\le10^{-13}$ at
$\theta^{(2)}$.
**Status: (i) VERIFIED ONLY for the designs tabulated** (the rank at one point proves generic identification
of the model *as built* there; the margin of $\theta^{(2)}$ is a measurement, and the order of $\lambda,\beta,\psi$
in $\theta$ and of the factors is now read from the source; a different order was tried by B0 under 40
random orders without a failure); **(ii) ESTABLISHED** (closed-form null directions, verified below).

#### SO2.2 Why $\theta^{(0)}$ is deficient, in each metric

B0 wrote that every second-order model is deficient at $\theta^{(0)}$ "because $B=0$ there". That is exact for
U and V and not for M and W, where $b_1=1$ is fixed and $B\neq0$.

**Result SO2.2.** At $\theta^{(0)}$ ($b_k=0$ for every free path): (a) in U and V every free path column of
$\Delta$ is exactly zero and the deficiency is $K$; (b) in M the deficiency is 1, with null vector
$(\mathrm d\psi_G,\mathrm d\psi_1)=(1,-1)$; (c) in W the deficiency is 1, with null vector $\mathrm d\psi_G=1$,
$\mathrm d\lambda_{j,F_1}=-\lambda/(2\Phi_{11})$. *Proof.* (a) At $B=0$, $\mathrm d\Phi=\mathrm dB\,\Psi+\Psi\,\mathrm dB^\top$,
and its only nonzero entries are $\Phi_{F_kG}$, which no item loads on: the path columns of $\Delta$ vanish.
(b) With $b_1=1$ and $b_{k\ge2}=0$, $\psi_G$ enters only $\Phi_{11}=\psi_G+\psi_1$ (the cross terms carry
$b_{k\ge2}$), exactly as $\psi_1$ does. (c) $\Phi_{11}=\psi_G+1$ and the loadings of $F_1$ enter through
$\lambda\sqrt{\Phi_{11}}$. $\square$ The second point moves the paths off zero (and $\psi$, $\lambda$ off their
starts), which is why it is the routine path for every second-order model, and why its being the optimizer's
start (`dwlsmv_id_rank.mata:105-111`) is needed here and not an accident.

```{r so-2-null}
options(width = 150)
# ---- why theta0 is deficient in each metric (K = 3, 4, 5), and what the null space is
so_2_def <- list()
for (so_K in 3:5) for (so_mn in names(so_mets)) {
  so_md <- so_build(rep(3, so_K), so_mets[[so_mn]][1], so_mets[[so_mn]][2]); so_th0 <- so_md$start
  so_D0 <- so_delta_cf(so_md, so_th0); so_sv <- svd(so_D0); so_rk <- sum(so_sv$d > 1e-8 * so_sv$d[1]); so_nb <- sum(so_md$fr$type == "b")
  so_jb <- which(so_md$fr$type == "b")
  if (so_mn %in% c("U", "V")) {       # every free path column vanishes where B = 0: G has no items
    so_check(paste("SO2 theta0 U/V: path columns are zero, K =", so_K, so_mn), max(abs(so_D0[, so_jb])) < 1e-12 && so_rk == so_md$npar_s - so_K)
  }
  if (so_mn == "M") {                 # psi_G and psi_1 enter only Phi_11 = psi_G + psi_1 when b_2 = ... = 0, b_1 = 1
    so_v <- rep(0, so_md$npar_s); so_v[which(so_md$fr$type == "p" & so_md$fr$r == 1)] <- 1; so_v[which(so_md$fr$type == "p" & so_md$fr$r == 2)] <- -1
    so_check(paste("SO2 theta0 M: null vector (psi_G, psi_1) = (1, -1), K =", so_K), max(abs(so_D0 %*% so_v)) < 1e-9 && so_rk == so_md$npar_s - 1)
  }
  if (so_mn == "W") {                 # psi_G enters Phi_11 = psi_G + 1; compensated by the loadings of F_1
    so_v <- rep(0, so_md$npar_s); so_v[which(so_md$fr$type == "p" & so_md$fr$r == 1)] <- 1
    so_j1 <- which(so_md$fr$type == "l" & so_md$fr$c == 2); so_v[so_j1] <- -0.7 / (2 * 2)
    so_check(paste("SO2 theta0 W: null vector (psi_G, F_1 loadings), K =", so_K), max(abs(so_D0 %*% so_v)) < 1e-9 && so_rk == so_md$npar_s - 1)
  }
  so_2_def[[length(so_2_def) + 1]] <- data.frame(K = so_K, metric = so_mn, free = so_md$npar_s, rank_theta0 = so_rk, deficiency = so_md$npar_s - so_rk)
}
so_2_def <- do.call(rbind, so_2_def); so_2_def

# ---- the production report when both points fail (reconstructed from dwls_identify's messages)
so_report <- function(so_md) {
  so_r <- so_rankcheck(so_md); so_D0 <- so_delta_fd(so_md, so_r$th0); s <- svd(so_D0); nv <- s$v[, (so_r$rank0 - so_md$T + 1):so_md$npar_s, drop = FALSE]
  so_nm <- paste0(ifelse(so_md$fr$type == "l", "lambda[", ifelse(so_md$fr$type == "b", "beta[", "psi[")),
               ifelse(so_md$fr$type == "l", paste0(so_md$itemn[so_md$fr$r], ","), paste0(so_md$facn[so_md$fr$r], ",")),
               ifelse(so_md$fr$type == "l", so_md$facn[so_md$fr$c], so_md$facn[so_md$fr$c]), "]")
  list(rank0 = so_r$rank0, rank2 = so_r$rank2, npar = so_r$npar,
       loads = lapply(seq_len(ncol(nv)), function(so_j) so_nm[abs(nv[, so_j]) > 0.1]))
}
so_m2 <- so_report(so_build(c(3, 3), "marker", "item")); so_mt1 <- so_report(so_build(c(3, 3, 1), "marker", "item"))
so_mt1u <- so_report(so_build(c(3, 3, 1), "var", "dist"))
str(so_m2[1:3]); so_m2$loads; str(so_mt1[1:3]); so_mt1$loads

# G over two: the closed-form null direction at any point (M metric): (b_2, psi_G, psi_1, psi_2) -> (b_2, -psi_G, psi_G, -b_2^2 psi_G)
so_md <- so_build(c(3, 3), "marker", "item"); so_r <- so_rankcheck(so_md); so_th <- so_r$th2
so_v <- rep(0, so_md$npar_s); so_ip <- function(ty, rr, cc) which(so_md$fr$type == ty & so_md$fr$r == rr & so_md$fr$c == cc)
so_b2 <- so_th[so_ip("b", 3, 1)]; so_pG <- so_th[so_ip("p", 1, 1)]
so_v[so_ip("b", 3, 1)] <- so_b2; so_v[so_ip("p", 1, 1)] <- -so_pG; so_v[so_ip("p", 2, 2)] <- so_pG; so_v[so_ip("p", 3, 3)] <- -so_b2^2 * so_pG
so_check("SO2 K=2 closed-form null direction (M)", max(abs(so_delta_cf(so_md, so_th) %*% so_v)) < 1e-12 * max(abs(so_v)) && so_r$rank2 == so_r$npar - 1)
# ... and the constrained variants (both paths fixed at 1) are full rank at both points
for (so_mn in names(so_mets)) so_check(paste("SO2 K=2 with b_2 fixed 1 is full rank", so_mn),
  so_rankcheck(so_build(c(3, 3), so_mets[[so_mn]][1], so_mets[[so_mn]][2], fixb = 2L))$pass0)

# a single-item first-order factor: exact null direction in each metric
for (so_mn in names(so_mets)) {
  so_md <- so_build(c(3, 3, 1), so_mets[[so_mn]][1], so_mets[[so_mn]][2]); so_th <- so_rand_theta(so_md, 7); so_D <- so_delta_cf(so_md, so_th)
  so_ip <- function(ty, rr, cc) which(so_md$fr$type == ty & so_md$fr$r == rr & so_md$fr$c == cc); so_v <- rep(0, so_md$npar_s)
  if (so_mn %in% c("M", "V")) so_v[so_ip("p", 5, 5)] <- 1            # psi_3 enters only Phi_33: no pair of distinct items sees it
  else { so_v[so_ip("l", 7, 5)] <- so_th[so_ip("l", 7, 5)]; so_v[so_ip("b", 5, 1)] <- -so_th[so_ip("b", 5, 1)] }   # (lambda_s, b_3) -> (t lambda_s, b_3 / t)
  so_check(paste("SO2 single-item factor: exact null direction", so_mn), max(abs(so_D %*% so_v)) < 1e-12)
}
```

The table shows rank at $\theta^{(0)}$ for $K=3,4,5$: M and W lose one, U and V lose $K$, each by the
vectors the checks assert. B0's "rank 11 of 12" (G over three) is the M and W figure; in U and V it is 9
of 12.

**What is reported when both points fail** (`dwlsmv_id_rank.mata:114-155`): the line "rank(Delta) is $r_0$
at the starting values but $n$ parameter(s) are free", then either "$k$ parameter(s) are redundant" (if the
second point has the same rank) or "$k$ parameter(s) are redundant here and $k_2$ at a second point", then
one block per null direction **of $\theta^{(0)}$** listing the parameters with $|v_j|>0.1$. For **M2** (M metric) rank is
`r so_m2$rank0` of `r so_m2$npar` at both points, one direction, and the parameters named are
`r paste(so_m2$loads[[1]], collapse = " and ")` only: the redundancy's real form involves $b_2$ and $\psi_2$ as well, but
$b_2=0$ at the start so those components vanish there. The report is accurate and incomplete. For **MT1** rank is
`r so_mt1$rank0` at $\theta^{(0)}$ and `r so_mt1$rank2` at $\theta^{(2)}$ of `r so_mt1$npar`: "2 redundant here and 1 at a second
point", two directions, one naming `r paste(so_mt1$loads[[1]], collapse = ", ")` (the real one) and one the starts-only
$\psi_G,\psi_1$ pair. Neither says "a first-order factor with one item" or "$G$ over two factors"; that wording is B3's.

#### SO2.3 The relation to the correlated-first-order model

This is a statement about moment sets, not about identification.

**$K=3$.** The correlated model has $\Phi_{FF}$ free (6 numbers), the second-order model (M) has
$(\psi_G,b_2,b_3,\psi_1,\psi_2,\psi_3)$ (6 numbers) and the same $\Lambda$ (6 free loadings): **the same degrees
of freedom** (24 at $p=9$), and $\sigma$ depends on the second-order parameters through $\Phi_{FF}$ only.

**Result SO2.3 (the map).** For $\Phi_{12}\Phi_{13}\Phi_{23}\ne0$ the second-order point
$$\psi_G=\frac{\Phi_{12}\Phi_{13}}{\Phi_{23}},\quad b_2=\frac{\Phi_{23}}{\Phi_{13}},\quad b_3=\frac{\Phi_{23}}{\Phi_{12}},\quad
\psi_k=\Phi_{kk}-b_k^2\psi_G\ (b_1=1)$$
has $\psi_G\gamma\gamma^\top+\Psi_F=\Phi_{FF}$ exactly, and it is the only one that does (the three
off-diagonals determine $\psi_G,b_2,b_3$). It is **proper** ($\psi_G>0$, every $\psi_k\ge0$) **iff**
$$\Phi_{12}\Phi_{13}\Phi_{23}>0\quad\text{and}\quad r_{kl}r_{km}/r_{lm}\le1\ \text{for each }k$$
($r$ the factor correlations; the second is "every standardized second-order loading at most 1": $b_k^{*2}=r_{kl}r_{km}/r_{lm}$).
*Proof.* $\psi_G=\Phi_{12}\Phi_{13}\Phi_{23}/\Phi_{23}^2$ has the sign of the product. Given that,
$\psi_1=\Phi_{11}-\Phi_{12}\Phi_{13}/\Phi_{23}\ge0\iff r_{12}r_{13}/r_{23}\le1$, and likewise for $k=2,3$.
A covariance matrix with exactly one off-diagonal zero has no preimage (it would need $\psi_Gb_kb_l=0$ for one
pair and $\ne0$ for the others), and one with all three zero needs $\psi_G=0$ or two paths zero. $\square$
So the two models have the same degrees of freedom and, for data whose correlated
optimum has all three $\Phi_{kl}\neq0$, the **same minimized objective**; they are **the same model only on
the region**; outside it the second-order fit is the correlated model's with an improper value, a negative
$\psi_k$ (loading above 1) or a negative $\psi_G$ (product of correlations negative). The argument is the same in
every metric (SO3 maps one to another); the improper value is representable in M and W (negative $\psi_G$), M and V
(negative $\psi_k$), SO3.3.

```{r so-2-rel}
# ---- K = 3: the second-order model against the correlated first-order model (marker metric, items 1, 4, 7 are markers)
so_k3_map <- function(Phi) {                 # Phi: the 3 x 3 factor covariance of the correlated model, item-marker scale
  so_psiG <- Phi[1, 2] * Phi[1, 3] / Phi[2, 3]; so_b <- c(1, Phi[2, 3] / Phi[1, 3], Phi[2, 3] / Phi[1, 2])
  list(psiG = so_psiG, b = so_b, psi = diag(Phi) - so_b^2 * so_psiG)
}
so_k3_status <- function(Phi) {              # region of equal models, read from the correlation matrix alone
  so_R <- cov2cor(Phi); so_bs2 <- c(so_R[1, 2] * so_R[1, 3] / so_R[2, 3], so_R[1, 2] * so_R[2, 3] / so_R[1, 3], so_R[1, 3] * so_R[2, 3] / so_R[1, 2])
  list(prod = so_R[1, 2] * so_R[1, 3] * so_R[2, 3], bstar2 = so_bs2, inside = so_R[1, 2] * so_R[1, 3] * so_R[2, 3] > 0 && all(so_bs2 <= 1))
}
so_md3 <- so_build(rep(3, 3), "marker", "item"); set.seed(11)
so_Lam <- matrix(0, 9, 3); so_Lam[cbind(1:9, rep(1:3, each = 3))] <- c(1, .8, .7, 1, .6, .9, 1, .7, .8)
so_mkPhi <- function(so_r, s = c(1, 1.3, .8)) { so_R <- diag(3); so_R[1, 2] <- so_R[2, 1] <- so_r[1]; so_R[1, 3] <- so_R[3, 1] <- so_r[2]; so_R[2, 3] <- so_R[3, 2] <- so_r[3]; diag(s) %*% so_R %*% diag(s) }
so_cases <- list(inside = c(.6, .5, .4), inside_negpair = c(-.6, -.5, .4), loading_above_1 = c(.8, .8, .4),
                 negative_product = c(.5, .5, -.4), mixed_improper = c(.9, -.8, -.6))
so_k3 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(so_cases), function(so_nm) {
  Phi <- so_mkPhi(so_cases[[so_nm]]); mp <- so_k3_map(Phi); st <- so_k3_status(Phi)
  # the second-order model at the mapped point, items 1,4,7 markers
  so_x <- so_mats(so_md3, c(so_Lam[cbind(c(2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9), rep(1:3, each = 2))], mp$b[2:3], mp$psiG, mp$psi))
  sig_so <- so_sigma(so_x$L, so_x$B, so_x$P)
  sig_c <- so_sigma(so_Lam, matrix(0, 3, 3), Phi)
  so_check(paste("SO2 K=3 round trip Phi = psi_G gamma gamma' + Psi_F:", so_nm), so_rel(mp$psiG * outer(mp$b, mp$b) + diag(mp$psi), Phi) < 1e-12)
  so_check(paste("SO2 K=3 same sigma at the mapped point:", so_nm), so_rel(sig_so, sig_c) < 1e-12)
  so_check(paste("SO2 K=3 proper iff inside the region:", so_nm), (mp$psiG > 0 && all(mp$psi >= 0)) == st$inside)
  data.frame(case = so_nm, r12 = so_cases[[so_nm]][1], r13 = so_cases[[so_nm]][2], r23 = so_cases[[so_nm]][3], product = st$prod,
             psi_G = mp$psiG, min_psi_k = min(mp$psi), max_bstar2 = max(st$bstar2), inside = st$inside)
}))
so_k3[, 5:9] <- lapply(so_k3[, 5:9], function(so_z) if (is.numeric(so_z)) signif(so_z, 3) else so_z); so_k3
so_check("SO2 K=3 same number of free parameters (12) and moments", so_md3$npar_s == 12 && 12 == 6 + 3 + 3)

# ---- K >= 4: K(K-3)/2 restrictions, by counting dimensions and by tetrads
so_tetrads <- function(so_K) {                  # all tetrad polynomials phi_ij phi_kl - phi_ik phi_jl on the off-diagonal of Phi
  idx <- which(lower.tri(diag(so_K)), arr.ind = TRUE); key <- function(so_i, so_j) which(idx[, 1] == max(so_i, so_j) & idx[, 2] == min(so_i, so_j))
  out <- list()
  for (cmb in if (so_K >= 4) combn(so_K, 4, simplify = FALSE) else list()) { so_a <- cmb[1]; so_b <- cmb[2]; c <- cmb[3]; so_d <- cmb[4]
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- c(key(so_a, so_b), key(c, so_d), key(so_a, c), key(so_b, so_d))
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- c(key(so_a, so_b), key(c, so_d), key(so_a, so_d), key(so_b, c)) }
  list(idx = idx, t = out)
}
so_phioff <- function(so_b, so_psiG) { P <- so_psiG * outer(so_b, so_b); P[lower.tri(P)] }        # off-diagonal of Phi_FF under the second-order form
so_2_tet <- list()
for (so_K in 3:8) {
  set.seed(so_K); so_b <- c(1, runif(so_K - 1, .4, 1.2)); so_psiG <- runif(1, .5, 1.5); so_n <- so_K * (so_K - 1) / 2
  so_f <- function(so_z) so_phioff(c(1, so_z[-1]), so_z[1]); so_z0 <- c(so_psiG, so_b[-1])
  so_J <- matrix(0, so_n, so_K); for (so_j in 1:so_K) { so_h <- 1e-6; so_zp <- so_z0; so_zm <- so_z0; so_zp[so_j] <- so_zp[so_j] + so_h; so_zm[so_j] <- so_zm[so_j] - so_h; so_J[, so_j] <- (so_f(so_zp) - so_f(so_zm)) / (2 * so_h) }
  so_sv <- svd(so_J)$d; so_rk <- sum(so_sv > 1e-6 * so_sv[1])
  so_tt <- so_tetrads(so_K); so_phi0 <- so_f(so_z0)
  so_tv <- if (length(so_tt$t)) sapply(so_tt$t, function(q) so_phi0[q[1]] * so_phi0[q[2]] - so_phi0[q[3]] * so_phi0[q[4]]) else 0
  # independent restrictions = rank of the tetrad gradients at a point of the model
  if (length(so_tt$t)) { so_G <- t(sapply(so_tt$t, function(q) { so_g <- rep(0, so_n); so_g[q[1]] <- so_phi0[q[2]]; so_g[q[2]] <- so_phi0[q[1]]; so_g[q[3]] <- -so_phi0[q[4]]; so_g[q[4]] <- -so_phi0[q[3]]; so_g })); so_sg <- svd(so_G)$d; so_nr <- sum(so_sg > 1e-9 * so_sg[1]) } else so_nr <- 0
  so_2_tet[[length(so_2_tet) + 1]] <- data.frame(K = so_K, offdiag_moments = so_n, model_dim = so_rk, restrictions = so_n - so_rk, KK3half = so_K * (so_K - 3) / 2, tetrad_gradient_rank = so_nr, max_abs_tetrad = max(abs(so_tv)))
  so_check(paste("SO2 rank of the off-diagonal map is K, K =", so_K), so_rk == so_K)
  so_check(paste("SO2 K(K-3)/2 restrictions, K =", so_K), so_n - so_rk == so_K * (so_K - 3) / 2 && so_nr == so_K * (so_K - 3) / 2)
  so_check(paste("SO2 tetrads vanish on the second-order form, K =", so_K), max(abs(so_tv)) < 1e-14)
}
so_2_tet <- do.call(rbind, so_2_tet); so_2_tet$max_abs_tetrad <- signif(so_2_tet$max_abs_tetrad, 2); so_2_tet
# degrees of freedom by the model's own parameter table: second-order minus correlated first-order
so_dfgain <- sapply(3:7, function(so_K) { so_md <- so_build(rep(3, so_K), "marker", "item"); np <- so_md$npar_s; p <- 3 * so_K
  (p * (p - 1) / 2 - np) - (p * (p - 1) / 2 - (2 * so_K + so_K * (so_K + 1) / 2)) })
so_check("SO2 df gain K = 3..7 is K(K-3)/2", identical(as.numeric(so_dfgain), (3:7) * ((3:7) - 3) / 2))
# two correlated G's: one covariance, and the gain K(K) = (K^2 - 3K - 2)/2 for K = K1 + K2 (M22: 1, M33: 8)
so_g2 <- sapply(list(c(2, 2), c(3, 3)), function(sp) { so_K <- sum(sp); so_md <- so_build(rep(3, so_K), "marker", "item", so_ng = 2, gsplit = sp)
  p <- 3 * so_K; (p * (p - 1) / 2 - so_md$npar_s) - (p * (p - 1) / 2 - (2 * so_K + so_K * (so_K + 1) / 2)) })
so_check("SO2 two G's: df gain 1 (2+2) and 8 (3+3)", identical(as.numeric(so_g2), c(1, 8)))

# ---- rank is lost at particular values: one path at zero (K = 3 only), all paths at zero (every K)
so_2_zero <- list()
for (so_K in 3:4) for (so_mn in names(so_mets)) {
  so_md <- so_build(rep(3, so_K), so_mets[[so_mn]][1], so_mets[[so_mn]][2]); so_th <- so_rand_theta(so_md, 21 + so_K)
  so_jb <- which(so_md$fr$type == "b"); so_th1 <- so_th; so_th1[so_jb[1]] <- 0; so_thall <- so_th; so_thall[so_jb] <- 0
  so_r1 <- so_numrank(so_delta_cf(so_md, so_th1), 0); so_ra <- so_numrank(so_delta_cf(so_md, so_thall), 0); so_r0 <- so_numrank(so_delta_cf(so_md, so_th), 0)
  so_2_zero[[length(so_2_zero) + 1]] <- data.frame(K = so_K, metric = so_mn, free = so_md$npar_s, generic = so_r0$rank, one_path_zero = so_r1$rank, all_paths_zero = so_ra$rank)
  so_check(paste("SO2 one free path at zero: rank loss iff K = 3, K =", so_K, so_mn), so_r0$rank == so_md$npar_s && (so_r1$rank == so_md$npar_s - (so_K == 3)))
  so_check(paste("SO2 all free paths at zero loses rank, K =", so_K, so_mn), so_ra$rank < so_md$npar_s)
}
so_2_zero <- do.call(rbind, so_2_zero); so_2_zero
```

The first table runs five designed correlation patterns: the model is proper only in the first two, and the
mapped second-order point reproduces $\sigma$ in all five (the check asserts both). The B0 example
$(.8,.8,.4)$ is the third row ($b^{*2}_1=1.6$, $\psi_1<0$). The B0 count that about 80% of uniformly drawn
$3\times3$ correlation matrices lie outside the region is a statement about that sampling scheme and is not
used here.
**Status: ESTABLISHED.**

**$K\ge4$: $K(K-3)/2$ restrictions.** The off-diagonal entries of $\Phi_{FF}$ are $\psi_Gb_kb_l$, $k<l$: $K(K-1)/2$ numbers
generated by $K$ parameters ($\psi_G$ and $b_2,\dots,b_K$ with $b_1=1$) while the variances $\Phi_{kk}$ stay free through
$\psi_k$.
**Result SO2.4.** The map $(\psi_G,b)\mapsto(\psi_Gb_kb_l)_{k<l}$ has rank $K$ at every point with $\psi_G\prod b_k\ne0$
for $K\ge3$, so the second-order model restricts $K(K-1)/2-K=K(K-3)/2$ combinations of the correlated model's
covariances: 2 at $K=4$, 5 at $K=5$, 9 at $K=6$. *Proof.* Take logs of absolute values:
$\log|\Phi_{kl}|=c+\beta_k+\beta_l$ with $c=\log|\psi_G|$, $\beta_k=\log|b_k|$. Its matrix is $[\mathbf 1\ |\ N]$, $N$ the
vertex-edge incidence matrix of the complete graph $K_K$, which has rank $K$ for $K\ge3$ ($K_K$ is not bipartite);
the shift $(c,\beta)\mapsto(c-2\delta,\beta+\delta)$ is its one null direction, leaving $K$ parameters of rank
$K$. $\square$ Those restrictions are the tetrad conditions $\Phi_{ij}\Phi_{kl}=\Phi_{il}\Phi_{kj}$. The chunk
verifies the rank of the numerical Jacobian, that every tetrad vanishes on the model to $10^{-14}$, that the
gradients of the tetrads have rank $K(K-3)/2$ (so these are the independent ones), and that
the degrees of freedom of the parameter tables differ by that amount, $K=3$ to 7 (the first table below
the cases). For **two** correlated $G$'s over $K_1+K_2=K$ factors the off-diagonal entries are generated by
$K+1$ numbers (two $\psi_G$, the covariance, and $K-2$ free paths), so the gain is $(K^2-3K-2)/2$:
1 for $2+2$, 8 for $3+3$, as in B0, checked on the tables.
**Status: ESTABLISHED.**

**SO2.5 Rank lost at particular values.** *One path at zero* costs rank when $K=3$ and not when $K\ge4$. If
$b_k=0$ the other $K-1$ factors give $\binom{K-1}{2}$ products $b_lb_m\psi_G$ with which to determine their $K-1$
paths (and $b_k$ itself is seen through the different entries $\Phi_{kl}=b_kb_l\psi_G$, with derivative
$b_l\psi_G\ne0$). For $K\ge4$ the incidence argument of SO2.4 on the $K-1\ge3$ other factors gives rank $K-1$
there; $K=4$ is the square case $(b_lb_m,b_lb_n,b_mb_n)$, Jacobian determinant $-2b_lb_mb_n\ne0$. At $K=3$ one
product, $b_2b_3$, cannot fix two paths, and the lost direction is
$(\mathrm db_2,\mathrm db_3,\mathrm d\psi_2,\mathrm d\psi_3)\propto(b_2,-b_3,-2b_2^2,2b_3^2)$ (V; SO3.4). *All paths at zero*
loses rank in every model (the last column of the table). **Status: ESTABLISHED** ($K=3$ in closed form;
$K=4$ by the determinant, verified at $K=3,4$ in all four metrics; $K\ge5$ by the incidence argument only).
**Scope (statement 4): none decided here.**

### Result SO3: the maps between the four metrics, and where each breaks down {#sec-so-metrics}

**SO3.1 (the maps).** @sec-marker-recovery Result 1 holds for *any* invertible diagonal $D$ over the latent
variables, $G$ included: with $\eta'=D\eta$,
$$\Lambda'=\Lambda D^{-1},\qquad B'=DBD^{-1},\qquad \Psi'=D\Psi D,\qquad \Phi'=D\Phi D,$$
so $\Lambda'\Phi'\Lambda'^\top=\Lambda\Phi\Lambda^\top$ and $\sigma$, $\Theta$, $F$, df are unchanged. Elementwise:
$\lambda_{jk}\mapsto\lambda_{jk}/d_k$, $b_k\mapsto b_kd_k/d_G$, $\psi_k\mapsto d_k^2\psi_k$, $\psi_G\mapsto d_G^2\psi_G$,
and with two $G$'s $\psi_{G_2G_1}\mapsto d_{G_1}d_{G_2}\psi_{G_2G_1}$. A metric is a choice of $d$ by the
target's fixed rows:

| target | $d_k$ (scale of $F_k$) | $d_G$ (scale of $G$; taken **after** the $F_k$ are rescaled) |
|---|---|---|
| M | $a_k$ = the marker loading in the source | $a_1b_1$ ($b_1$ the source's first path) |
| V | $a_k$ | $1/\sqrt{\psi_G}$ |
| W | $1/\sqrt{\psi_k}$ | $b_1d_1=b_1/\sqrt{\psi_1}$ |
| U | $1/\sqrt{\psi_k}$ | $1/\sqrt{\psi_G}$ |

where $a_k,b_1,\psi_k,\psi_G$ are the **source's** values (equal to 1 where the source fixes them). Order matters
because $b_1$ changes when $F_1$ is rescaled: $d_G=b_1$ instead of $a_1b_1$ leaves $b_1\ne1$ (checked). The
maps are consistent: doing U$\to$V$\to$M is U$\to$M, for all twelve ordered pairs (the groupoid of
the four metrics). The recovery draft's formulas are the U row of this table:
U$\to$M $\ \lambda\mapsto\lambda/a_k,\ b_k\mapsto a_kb_k/c,\ \psi_k\mapsto a_k^2,\ \psi_G\mapsto c^2$, $c=a_1b_1$;
U$\to$V $\ \lambda\mapsto\lambda/a_k,\ b_k\mapsto a_kb_k,\ \psi_k\mapsto a_k^2$, $\psi_G=1$.
M$\to$U needs $\psi_k>0$, $\psi_G>0$ and gives $b^U_k=b^M_k\sqrt{\psi_G}/\sqrt{\psi_k}$; M$\to$V needs only $\psi_G>0$.
**Status: ESTABLISHED** (algebra; the chunk checks the explicit $d$ against the generic map, that $\sigma$ is
unchanged and the target's fixed rows hold, and the composition, at generic points of each source metric;
SO4 checks the same maps against lavaan fits).

**SO3.2 (what keeps its meaning).** Every quantity that is a function of $\sigma$ alone: thresholds, fit,
df, the free-parameter count (the same in all four metrics), and the **standardized solution**
$\lambda s_f,\ b s_G/s_k,\ \psi/(s_fs_g)$: under $D$, $s_f=\sqrt{\Phi_{ff}}\mapsto d_fs_f$, so each of these is
invariant. What does not: the raw $\lambda$ of a first-order factor, the raw $b_k$, $\psi_k$ and $\psi_G$;
and **an equality or a fixed value of a raw path**, which is a restriction on $b_kd_k/d_G$ and so a different
set of models in different metrics (SO3.5). With unit disturbance variances the raw path equals
$b^*/\sqrt{1-b^{*2}}$ and is not a correlation (a standardized 0.847 is 1.59). The chunk
asserts the standardized solution equal to $10^{-12}$ across the four metrics at a generic point ($K=3,4$) and
prints the raw third path in each.

```{r so-3}

# ---- SO3.1  the twelve maps: d_k and d_G by the target metric, from named parameters of the source point
so_d_explicit <- function(so_x, so_K, nk, so_to, so_ng = 1) {          # one G; marker item = first item of each F_k; paths on G = column 1
  so_r1 <- cumsum(c(0, nk))[seq_len(so_K)] + 1; so_Fi <- so_ng + seq_len(so_K)
  so_dk <- if (so_to %in% c("M", "V")) sapply(seq_len(so_K), function(k) so_x$L[so_r1[k], so_Fi[k]]) else 1 / sqrt(diag(so_x$P)[so_Fi])
  b1p <- so_x$B[so_Fi[1], 1] * so_dk[1]                              # the first path AFTER the first-order factors are rescaled
  dG <- if (so_to %in% c("M", "W")) b1p else 1 / sqrt(so_x$P[1, 1])
  c(dG, so_dk)
}
for (so_src in names(so_mets)) {
  so_mds <- so_build(rep(3, 3), so_mets[[so_src]][1], so_mets[[so_src]][2]); so_th <- so_rand_theta(so_mds, 300); so_x <- so_mats(so_mds, so_th)
  for (so_to in names(so_mets)) {
    so_mdt <- so_build(rep(3, 3), so_mets[[so_to]][1], so_mets[[so_to]][2])
    so_d <- so_d_explicit(so_x, 3, rep(3, 3), so_to); so_y <- so_rescale(so_x, so_d)
    so_check(paste("SO3 explicit d reproduces the generic map", so_src, "to", so_to), max(abs(so_d - so_d_for(so_x, so_mdt))) < 1e-12)
    so_check(paste("SO3 sigma unchanged and the target's fixed rows hold", so_src, "to", so_to),
             so_rel(so_sigma(so_y$L, so_y$B, so_y$P), so_sigma(so_x$L, so_x$B, so_x$P)) < 1e-12 && so_fixed_ok(so_y, so_mdt))
    so_mdv <- so_build(rep(3, 3), "var", "item"); so_z <- so_to_metric(so_to_metric(so_x, so_mdv), so_mdt); so_w <- so_to_metric(so_x, so_mdt)
    so_check(paste("SO3 maps compose through V:", so_src, "to", so_to), max(abs(unlist(so_z) - unlist(so_w))) < 1e-10)
  }
}
# order matters: scaling G by the path BEFORE the first-order factors are rescaled does not give b_1 = 1
so_mdU <- so_build(rep(3, 3), "var", "dist")
so_xU <- so_mats(so_mdU, so_rand_theta(so_mdU, 5)); so_dk <- so_d_explicit(so_xU, 3, rep(3, 3), "M")[-1]
so_ywrong <- so_rescale(so_xU, c(so_xU$B[2, 1], so_dk)); so_ygood <- so_rescale(so_xU, so_d_explicit(so_xU, 3, rep(3, 3), "M"))
so_check("SO3 order of the two rescalings: c = a_1 b_1, not b_1", abs(so_ygood$B[2, 1] - 1) < 1e-12 && abs(so_ywrong$B[2, 1] - 1) > 0.05)

# ---- SO3.2  what keeps its meaning: the standardized solution, df, the free-parameter count, sigma
so_3_std <- list()
for (so_K in 3:4) {
  so_mdl <- lapply(so_mets, function(m) so_build(rep(3, so_K), m[1], m[2])); so_x0 <- so_mats(so_mdl$U, so_rand_theta(so_mdl$U, 40 + so_K))
  so_sg <- lapply(so_mdl, function(so_md) { so_y <- so_to_metric(so_x0, so_md); list(y = so_y, g = so_std_mats(so_y)) })
  so_gap <- sapply(so_sg, function(so_z) max(abs(c(so_z$g$L - so_sg$U$g$L, so_z$g$B - so_sg$U$g$B, so_z$g$P - so_sg$U$g$P, so_z$g$Th - so_sg$U$g$Th))))
  so_check(paste("SO3 standardized solution is the same in all four metrics, K =", so_K), max(so_gap) < 1e-12)
  so_check(paste("SO3 same number of free parameters in all four metrics, K =", so_K), length(unique(sapply(so_mdl, function(m) m$npar_s))) == 1)
  so_3_std[[length(so_3_std) + 1]] <- data.frame(K = so_K, free = so_mdl$M$npar_s, max_gap_std = signif(max(so_gap), 2),
    raw_b3_M = round(so_sg$M$y$B[3, 1], 3), raw_b3_U = round(so_sg$U$y$B[3, 1], 3), raw_b3_V = round(so_sg$V$y$B[3, 1], 3),
    raw_b3_W = round(so_sg$W$y$B[3, 1], 3), std_b3 = round(so_sg$U$g$B[3, 1], 3))
}
do.call(rbind, so_3_std)

# ---- SO3.3  where each metric breaks: representability of improper and boundary points
so_improper <- function(kind) {
  so_md <- so_build(rep(3, 3), "marker", "item")
  if (kind == "proper")  return(so_to_metric(so_std_point(so_md, c(.8, .7, .6)), so_md))
  if (kind == "psi_k<0") return(so_to_metric(so_std_point(so_md, c(1.2, .4, .4)), so_md))
  if (kind == "psi_k=0") return(so_to_metric(so_std_point(so_md, c(1, .5, .5)), so_md))
  if (kind == "psi_G<0") { so_x <- so_mats(so_md, so_rand_theta(so_md, 9)); so_x$P[1, 1] <- -0.5; so_x$P[2:4, 2:4] <- diag(c(1, 1.2, 1.1)); so_x$B[3:4, 1] <- c(.8, .7); return(so_x) }
}
so_3_rep <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("proper", "psi_k<0", "psi_k=0", "psi_G<0"), function(kind) {
  so_x <- so_improper(kind); row <- list(point = kind)
  for (so_to in names(so_mets)) {
    so_mdt <- so_build(rep(3, 3), so_mets[[so_to]][1], so_mets[[so_to]][2])
    so_y <- suppressWarnings(so_to_metric(so_x, so_mdt)); row[[so_to]] <- all(is.finite(unlist(so_y))) && so_fixed_ok(so_y, so_mdt)
  }
  as.data.frame(row)
}))
so_3_rep
so_check("SO3 representability: psi_k<0 and psi_k=0 in M and V only; psi_G<0 in M and W only; the proper point in all four",
  identical(unname(unlist(so_3_rep[2, 2:5])), c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)) && identical(unname(unlist(so_3_rep[3, 2:5])), c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)) &&
  identical(unname(unlist(so_3_rep[4, 2:5])), c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE, TRUE)) && all(unlist(so_3_rep[1, 2:5])))
# U's sigma range for K >= 3 is r_kl = b*_k b*_l with |b*| < 1, so b*_k^2 = r_kl r_km / r_lm < 1; the improper point is outside it
so_xi <- so_improper("psi_k<0"); so_R <- cov2cor(so_Phi(so_xi$B, so_xi$P)[2:4, 2:4])
so_check("SO3 U cannot represent psi_1<0: b*_1^2 = r12 r13 / r23 > 1 at the point", so_R[1, 2] * so_R[1, 3] / so_R[2, 3] > 1 + 1e-9)

# ---- SO3.5  K = 2: the same moments, two different "equal paths" (tie in M, tie in U)
so_Phi2 <- matrix(c(1, .5, .5, 1.5), 2); so_r12 <- so_Phi2[1, 2] / sqrt(so_Phi2[1, 1] * so_Phi2[2, 2])
so_bM <- c(sqrt(so_Phi2[1, 2] / so_Phi2[1, 1]), sqrt(so_Phi2[1, 2] / so_Phi2[2, 2]))   # M tie b = (1, 1): psi_G = Phi_12, psi_k = Phi_kk - Phi_12
so_bU <- rep(sqrt(so_r12), 2)                                                  # U tie: equal standardized paths, product r12
so_3_tie <- c(r12 = so_r12, M_tie_bstar1 = so_bM[1], M_tie_bstar2 = so_bM[2], prod_M = prod(so_bM), U_tie_bstar1 = so_bU[1], U_tie_bstar2 = so_bU[2], prod_U = prod(so_bU))
round(so_3_tie, 4)
so_check("SO3 K=2: the two ties give different standardized paths and the same product r12",
  abs(prod(so_bM) - so_r12) < 1e-12 && abs(prod(so_bU) - so_r12) < 1e-12 && abs(so_bM[1] - so_bU[1]) > 0.05)
```

**SO3.3 (what each metric can represent).** Read the table of SO3.1: **M** needs only $a_k\ne0$ and $c\ne0$ and has no sign restriction;
**V** needs $\psi_G>0$ (its $d_G=1/\sqrt{\psi_G}$) and nothing of $\psi_k$; **W** needs $\psi_k>0$ for every $k$ ($d_k=1/\sqrt{\psi_k}$) and nothing of $\psi_G$; **U** needs both.
So **U cannot represent $\psi_k\le0$**. At $\sigma$ level: in U, $b^{*2}=b^2/(1+b^2)<1$, every $\sigma$ in its range has $r_{kl}=b^*_kb^*_l$ with $|b^*|<1$, and at $K\ge3$
$b^{*2}_k=r_{kl}r_{km}/r_{lm}$ is determined by $\sigma$, so a point with $b^{*2}_k>1$ has no preimage. **V and M can** represent $\psi_k<0$ and $\psi_k=0$ (their $\psi_k$ is free);
**V cannot represent $\psi_G<0$** (at $K=3$ V's $\Phi_{12}\Phi_{13}\Phi_{23}=(b_1b_2b_3)^2>0$, so the improper region of SO2.3 with a negative product is outside V, as it is outside U); **W and M can**. The boundary
$\psi_k=0$ (a standardized loading of exactly 1) is a point of M and V and is at infinity in U and W. The table asserts exactly this on four points, each mapped from M into every
metric: proper, $\psi_1<0$, $\psi_1=0$, $\psi_G<0$.

**SO3.4 (conditioning).** *Measurement.* The structural block of $\Delta$ at one *population* point written in each metric, along three axes: a standardized second-order loading
$b^*_1=\varepsilon$ (the others $.7$), the standardized disturbance $\psi^*_1=\varepsilon^2$ (so $b^*_1\to1$), and the marker item's standardized loading $\varepsilon$; $K=3$ and $4$. Two condition
numbers: **unscaled** (production's own object: the rank check reads these singular values) and **scaled** (columns normalized to unit length, so that the size of a parameter does not
count). The table prints $\sigma_{\max}/\sigma_{\min}$ at $\varepsilon=10^{-3},10^{-4}$ and the slopes $d\log_{10}\text{cond}/d\log_{10}(1/\varepsilon)$ between $10^{-2}$ and $10^{-3}$ (the next
decade reaches $10^{16}$, double precision's limit, on several axes).

```{r so-3-cond}
# ---- SO3.4  conditioning of Delta along three axes, four metrics (structural block, closed form)
# unscaled = production's own object (the rank check reads the unscaled singular values); scaled = columns normalized to unit length
so_condprof <- function(so_K, so_axis, eps, so_mn) {
  so_md <- so_build(rep(3, so_K), so_mets[[so_mn]][1], so_mets[[so_mn]][2]); bs <- rep(.7, so_K)
  if (so_axis == "b1") bs[1] <- eps
  if (so_axis == "psi1") bs[1] <- sqrt(1 - eps^2)
  so_x <- so_std_point(so_md, bs); if (so_axis == "marker") so_x$L[1, so_md$ng + 1] <- eps
  so_y <- so_to_metric(so_x, so_md); stopifnot(so_fixed_ok(so_y, so_md)); so_D <- so_delta_cf(so_md, so_theta_of(so_md, so_y))
  so_sv <- svd(so_D)$d; ss <- svd(sweep(so_D, 2, sqrt(colSums(so_D^2)), "/"))$d
  c(unscaled = so_sv[1] / so_sv[length(so_sv)], scaled = ss[1] / ss[length(ss)])
}
so_3_cond <- list(); so_epss <- 10^-(1:5)
for (so_K in 3:4) for (so_axis in c("b1", "psi1", "marker")) for (so_mn in names(so_mets)) {
  so_cv <- sapply(so_epss, function(e) so_condprof(so_K, so_axis, e, so_mn)); so_sl <- apply(log10(so_cv), 1, function(so_z) diff(so_z) / 1)
  so_3_cond[[length(so_3_cond) + 1]] <- data.frame(K = so_K, axis = so_axis, metric = so_mn, cond_1e3 = signif(so_cv[1, 3], 3), cond_1e4 = signif(so_cv[1, 4], 3),
    slope_unscaled = unname(round(so_sl[2, "unscaled"], 3)), cond_scaled_1e3 = signif(so_cv[2, 3], 3), slope_scaled = unname(round(so_sl[2, "scaled"], 3)))
}
so_3_cond <- do.call(rbind, so_3_cond); rownames(so_3_cond) <- NULL; so_3_cond
so_slu <- function(so_K, so_axis, so_mn) so_3_cond$slope_unscaled[so_3_cond$K == so_K & so_3_cond$axis == so_axis & so_3_cond$metric == so_mn]
so_sls <- function(so_K, so_axis, so_mn) so_3_cond$slope_scaled[so_3_cond$K == so_K & so_3_cond$axis == so_axis & so_3_cond$metric == so_mn]
# slopes are over eps = 1e-2 to 1e-3 (one decade; the 1e-3 to 1e-4 window reaches cond ~ 1e16 on some axes, where double precision is the limit).
# The windows below (0.02) were chosen after measuring: the measured slopes are within 0.005 of an integer, or of 0.
so_w <- function(so_v, target, tol = .02) all(abs(so_v - target) < tol)
so_check("SO3 b_1 -> 0, K = 3, unscaled: V and U eps^-1; M and W eps^-4",
  so_w(c(so_slu(3, "b1", "U"), so_slu(3, "b1", "V")), 1) && so_w(c(so_slu(3, "b1", "M"), so_slu(3, "b1", "W")), 4))
so_check("SO3 b_1 -> 0, K = 4, unscaled: V and U bounded; M and W eps^-4", so_w(c(so_slu(4, "b1", "U"), so_slu(4, "b1", "V")), 0) && so_w(c(so_slu(4, "b1", "M"), so_slu(4, "b1", "W")), 4))
so_check("SO3 b_1 -> 0, scaled: eps^-1 in all four at K = 3; at K = 4 bounded for V and U, eps^-1 for M and W",
  so_w(sapply(names(so_mets), function(m) so_sls(3, "b1", m)), 1) && so_w(c(so_sls(4, "b1", "U"), so_sls(4, "b1", "V")), 0) && so_w(c(so_sls(4, "b1", "M"), so_sls(4, "b1", "W")), 1))
so_check("SO3 psi_1 -> 0 (eps = sqrt of the standardized disturbance), unscaled: M and V bounded, U eps^-4, W eps^-5",
  so_w(c(so_slu(3, "psi1", "M"), so_slu(3, "psi1", "V")), 0) && so_w(so_slu(3, "psi1", "U"), 4) && so_w(so_slu(3, "psi1", "W"), 5))
so_check("SO3 psi_1 -> 0, scaled: M and V bounded, U and W eps^-2", so_w(c(so_sls(3, "psi1", "M"), so_sls(3, "psi1", "V")), 0) && so_w(c(so_sls(3, "psi1", "U"), so_sls(3, "psi1", "W")), 2))
so_check("SO3 marker item loading -> 0: M and V eps^-4 unscaled and eps^-1 scaled (item markers); U and W bounded",
  so_w(c(so_slu(3, "marker", "M"), so_slu(3, "marker", "V")), 4, .05) && so_w(c(so_sls(3, "marker", "M"), so_sls(3, "marker", "V")), 1) &&
  so_w(c(so_slu(3, "marker", "U"), so_slu(3, "marker", "W"), so_sls(3, "marker", "U"), so_sls(3, "marker", "W")), 0))
# conditioning through and beyond the boundary: psi_1 < 0 (M and V only)
so_3_imp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c(1.0001, 1.01, 1.05, 1.2, 1.5), function(b1) {
  so_r <- sapply(c("M", "V"), function(so_mn) { so_md <- so_build(rep(3, 3), so_mets[[so_mn]][1], so_mets[[so_mn]][2])
    so_x <- so_std_point(so_md, c(b1, .7, .7)); so_y <- so_to_metric(so_x, so_md); so_sv <- svd(so_delta_cf(so_md, so_theta_of(so_md, so_y)))$d
    c(so_sv[1] / so_sv[length(so_sv)], sum(so_sv > 1e-8 * so_sv[1])) })
  data.frame(bstar_1 = b1, psi_1 = round(1 - b1^2, 4), cond_M = signif(so_r[1, 1], 3), cond_V = signif(so_r[1, 2], 3), rank_M = so_r[2, 1], rank_V = so_r[2, 2])
}))
so_3_imp
so_check("SO3 M and V keep full rank and a modest condition number through psi_1 < 0 (chosen after measuring: 30)",
  all(so_3_imp$rank_M == 12 & so_3_imp$rank_V == 12) && max(so_3_imp$cond_V) < 30)
# the rate for V, K = 3, b_1 = eps: an exact null direction at eps = 0, and Delta(eps) v0 = O(eps)
so_mdV <- so_build(rep(3, 3), "var", "item")
so_v0at <- function(eps) {
  so_x <- so_to_metric(so_std_point(so_mdV, c(eps, .7, .7)), so_mdV); so_th <- so_theta_of(so_mdV, so_x); fr <- so_mdV$fr
  so_v <- rep(0, nrow(fr)); ib <- function(k) which(fr$type == "b" & fr$r == 1 + k)
  so_b2 <- so_th[ib(2)]; b3 <- so_th[ib(3)]; so_v[ib(2)] <- so_b2; so_v[ib(3)] <- -b3
  so_v[which(fr$type == "p" & fr$r == 3)] <- -2 * so_b2^2; so_v[which(fr$type == "p" & fr$r == 4)] <- 2 * b3^2
  list(D = so_delta_cf(so_mdV, so_th), v = so_v)
}
so_z0 <- so_v0at(0)
so_check("SO3 V, K = 3, b_1 = 0: v0 = (b_2, -b_3, -2 b_2^2, 2 b_3^2) is an exact null direction", max(abs(so_z0$D %*% so_z0$v)) < 1e-12)
so_rt <- sapply(10^-(2:5), function(e) { so_z <- so_v0at(e); sqrt(sum((so_z$D %*% so_z$v)^2)) / (e * sqrt(sum(so_z$v^2))) })
so_smn <- sapply(10^-(2:5), function(e) { so_z <- so_v0at(e); min(svd(so_z$D)$d) / e })
so_check("SO3 V, K = 3: |Delta(eps) v0| / (eps |v0|) and sigma_min / eps tend to constants (ratios of the last two within 1%)",
  abs(so_rt[4] / so_rt[3] - 1) < 1e-2 && abs(so_smn[4] / so_smn[3] - 1) < 1e-2)
rbind(`|Delta v0| / (eps |v0|)` = so_rt, `sigma_min / eps` = so_smn)
```

The result, with slopes from the table (a number is the exponent of $1/\varepsilon$; "b" is bounded):

| axis | M | U | V | W |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| $b_1^*\to0$, $K=3$ | 4 (scaled 1) | 1 (1) | 1 (1) | 4 (1) |
| $b_1^*\to0$, $K=4$ | 4 (1) | b (b) | b (b) | 4 (1) |
| $\psi_1^*\to0$ ($\varepsilon=\sqrt{\psi_1^*}$) | b (b) | 4 (2) | b (b) | 5 (2) |
| $\psi_1<0$ | represents; cond 12 to 17 | cannot | represents; cond 8.8 to 13 | cannot |
| marker item loading $\to0$ | 4 (1) | b (b) | 4 (1) | b (b) |

**The question the owner asked about V.** *V combines U's conditioning at small second-order paths with M's ability to represent an improper solution: confirmed, with one caveat.*
(a) At $b_1\to0$ V is as well-conditioned as U, in both measures: $\varepsilon^{-1}$ at $K=3$ (where the model itself loses rank at $b_1=0$, SO2.5) and bounded at $K\ge4$, against M's 4 (unscaled) and 1 (scaled) at $K\ge4$.
(b) V represents $\psi_k=0$ and $\psi_k<0$ with a condition number of 8.8 to 13 through $b^*_1$ from 1.0001 to 1.5 (`so_3_imp`; M: 12 to 17), while U's grows like $\varepsilon^{-4}$ toward the
boundary and then has no point. (c) The caveat: V keeps M's **item** markers, so it inherits M's rate when a *marker item's* loading goes to 0 (4 unscaled, 1 scaled), which U and W do not. (d) V cannot represent $\psi_G<0$;
M and W can. W is the worst on every axis it can represent: it has M's latent marker ($b_1\to0$: 4) and U's unit disturbances ($\psi^*\to0$: 5) and represents neither improper value of $\psi_k$.
The unscaled and scaled rates differ by a function of parameter size (in M at $K=3$, the other paths are of order $1/\varepsilon$ and $\psi_G$ of order $\varepsilon^2$); that the metric changes the *scale* of the
parameters but not (at $K=3$) the rate in the scaled measure is the sense in which the metric choice is not about identification.

*What is derived, and what is only measured.* $K=3$, V (and U): at $b_1=0$ the direction
$v_0=(\mathrm db_2,\mathrm db_3,\mathrm d\psi_2,\mathrm d\psi_3)=(b_2,-b_3,-2b_2^2,2b_3^2)$ is an exact null direction of $\Delta$: $\mathrm d\Phi_{12}=b_2\mathrm db_1+b_1\mathrm db_2=b_2\mathrm db_1$ and
$\mathrm d\Phi_{13}=b_3\mathrm db_1$ force $\mathrm db_1=0$ in the null space, $\mathrm d\Phi_{23}=b_3\mathrm db_2+b_2\mathrm db_3=0$ gives $v_0$'s first two entries, $\mathrm d\Phi_{kk}=0$ its last two.
At $b_1=\varepsilon$ the same $v_0$ gives $\mathrm d\Phi_{12}=\varepsilon b_2$ and $\mathrm d\Phi_{13}=-\varepsilon b_3$, so $\Delta(\varepsilon)v_0=O(\varepsilon)$ and not $o(\varepsilon)$, while every other singular value stays away
from 0 (rank 11 of 12 at $\varepsilon=0$): $\sigma_{\min}=\Theta(\varepsilon)$, cond $\propto\varepsilon^{-1}$. The chunk finds both $\|\Delta(\varepsilon)v_0\|/(\varepsilon\|v_0\|)$ and $\sigma_{\min}/\varepsilon$ equal to
`r round(so_smn[4], 4)` for $\varepsilon\le10^{-3}$. At $K\ge4$ the point $b_1=0$ has full rank (SO2.5), so the conditioning is bounded near it by continuity. At $\psi^*_1\to0$ the coordinates of M and V stay finite
and the point $\psi_1=0$ is a regular point of $\Delta$ (full rank, a polynomial in these coordinates), so they stay bounded; U's and W's coordinates diverge ($b\to\infty$). **Not derived:** the rates 4 and 5 (unscaled), and
the scaled rate 2 for U and W at $\psi^*\to0$, 1 for M and W at $K=4$; they are measured (slopes within 0.005 of the integer). A bound through $\Delta_M=\Delta_VJ$, $J=\partial\theta_V/\partial\theta_M$,
only gives the bound $\operatorname{cond}\Delta_M\le\operatorname{cond}\Delta_V\operatorname{cond}J$, which is not used. The recovery note's $\varepsilon^{-4}$ for M and for U at $\psi\to0$ are reproduced.
**Status: the $\varepsilon^{-1}$ rate of V and U at $K=3$, boundedness of V and U ($K\ge4$) and of M and V ($\psi\to0$): ESTABLISHED. The other rates, scaled and unscaled: VERIFIED ONLY (windows chosen after measuring).**

**SO3.5 (K = 2: a raw-path equality is metric-dependent).** In M, "both paths 1" fixes $b_1=b_2=1$:
$\Phi_{12}=\psi_G$, $\Phi_{kk}=\psi_G+\psi_k$, a bijection with the three entries of $\Phi$, so the tie
restricts nothing and the standardized paths are $b^*_k=\sqrt{\Phi_{12}/\Phi_{kk}}$. In U, "both paths equal"
gives $b^*_1=b^*_2=\sqrt{r_{12}}$. For the same $\sigma$ ($\Phi=(1,.5;.5,1.5)$, $r_{12}=.408$) the first gives
$(0.707,0.577)$, the second $(0.639,0.639)$; the product, the factor correlation, is the same. Both ties are
the correlated model reparameterized (equal $\sigma$, 15 moments, 7 free parameters), but they pick different
points of the same identified set, so "the second-order loadings are equal" means a different thing in M
(equal in marker-scaled units, not scale-free) than in U (equal standardized loadings). An equality of raw
second-order paths is therefore only meaningful stated together with its metric. **Status: ESTABLISHED.**

### Result SO4: the unit-variance to marker transform for a latent anchor {#sec-so-recovery}

The question is whether @sec-marker-recovery extends to a factor whose anchor is a path. This subsection
derives what the mathematics gives and decides nothing about eligibility (the E1 to E3 rule of
`dwlsmv_m11_receligible.mata:11-15` as it stands refuses these models: $G$ has "no loading fixed at 1" and
the path fixed at 1 is "a fixed nonzero beta").

**Setup.** $\mathcal U$: every $\psi$ fixed 1 for $F_k$ and $G$ (unit disturbance, unit variance), loadings and
paths free. $\mathcal M$: item markers on the $F_k$, $b_1=1$, $\psi_k$ and $\psi_G$ free. Let $a_k=\lambda^{\mathcal U}_{m(k)k}$ be
the marker item's unit-variance loading and $c=a_1b^{\mathcal U}_1$. $\mathcal V$ is the intermediate metric
(item markers, $\psi_G=1$).

The point-level checks (no lavaan: explicit formulas against the generic map, the reflection orbit, stationarity, the improper case) are in the chunk below, which also defines the numbers quoted in SO4.4.

```{r so-4}
# ---- SO4: the unit-variance to marker transform for a latent anchor (point-level checks, no lavaan)
# explicit formulas for a U point (L, B, P) over K factors, one G; marker items are the first item of each F_k
so_h_UM <- function(so_x, so_K) {                    # U -> M: lambda / a_k, b_k a_k / c, psi_k = a_k^2, psi_G = c^2, c = a_1 b_1
  so_r1 <- 3 * (seq_len(so_K) - 1) + 1; so_a <- sapply(seq_len(so_K), function(k) so_x$L[so_r1[k], 1 + k]); so_b <- so_x$B[1 + seq_len(so_K), 1]; cc <- so_a[1] * so_b[1]
  L <- so_x$L; for (k in seq_len(so_K)) L[, 1 + k] <- L[, 1 + k] / so_a[k]
  B <- so_x$B; B[1 + seq_len(so_K), 1] <- so_a * so_b / cc
  P <- diag(c(cc^2, so_a^2), so_K + 1); list(L = L, B = B, P = P, a = so_a, c = cc)
}
so_h_UV <- function(so_x, so_K) {                    # U -> V: lambda / a_k, b_k a_k, psi_k = a_k^2, psi_G = 1
  so_r1 <- 3 * (seq_len(so_K) - 1) + 1; so_a <- sapply(seq_len(so_K), function(k) so_x$L[so_r1[k], 1 + k]); so_b <- so_x$B[1 + seq_len(so_K), 1]
  L <- so_x$L; for (k in seq_len(so_K)) L[, 1 + k] <- L[, 1 + k] / so_a[k]
  B <- so_x$B; B[1 + seq_len(so_K), 1] <- so_a * so_b
  list(L = L, B = B, P = diag(c(1, so_a^2), so_K + 1))
}
so_mdUk <- lapply(3:4, function(so_K) so_build(rep(3, so_K), "var", "dist")); so_mdMk <- lapply(3:4, function(so_K) so_build(rep(3, so_K), "marker", "item"))
so_mdVk <- lapply(3:4, function(so_K) so_build(rep(3, so_K), "var", "item"))
for (so_i in 1:2) {
  so_K <- so_i + 2; set.seed(400 + so_K)
  for (so_rep_ in 1:20) {
    so_th <- so_rand_theta(so_mdUk[[so_i]], 1000 * so_K + so_rep_)
    so_sg <- sample(c(-1, 1), so_K + 1, replace = TRUE)                   # a random point of the reflection orbit (U's sign group)
    so_x <- so_rescale(so_mats(so_mdUk[[so_i]], so_th), so_sg)
    so_hM <- so_h_UM(so_x, so_K); so_hV <- so_h_UV(so_x, so_K); so_gM <- so_to_metric(so_x, so_mdMk[[so_i]]); so_gV <- so_to_metric(so_x, so_mdVk[[so_i]])
    so_check(paste("SO4.1 explicit U->M = generic map, K =", so_K, so_rep_), max(abs(c(so_hM$L - so_gM$L, so_hM$B - so_gM$B, so_hM$P - so_gM$P))) < 1e-10 &&
             so_fixed_ok(so_hM, so_mdMk[[so_i]]) && so_rel(so_sigma(so_hM$L, so_hM$B, so_hM$P), so_sigma(so_x$L, so_x$B, so_x$P)) < 1e-12 && so_hM$P[1, 1] > 0 && all(diag(so_hM$P) > 0))
    so_check(paste("SO4.1 explicit U->V = generic map, K =", so_K, so_rep_), max(abs(c(so_hV$L - so_gV$L, so_hV$B - so_gV$B, so_hV$P - so_gV$P))) < 1e-10 &&
             so_fixed_ok(so_hV, so_mdVk[[so_i]]) && so_rel(so_sigma(so_hV$L, so_hV$B, so_hV$P), so_sigma(so_x$L, so_x$B, so_x$P)) < 1e-12)
    # SO4.2: h is constant on the orbit: the M and V images do not depend on the signs sg (and c may have either sign)
    so_x0 <- so_mats(so_mdUk[[so_i]], so_th); so_h0 <- so_h_UM(so_x0, so_K); so_v0 <- so_h_UV(so_x0, so_K)
    so_check(paste("SO4.2 h_UM is constant on the 2^(K+1) reflection orbit; h_UV is constant under the F-flips and its paths change sign with G, K =", so_K, so_rep_),
             max(abs(c(so_hM$L - so_h0$L, so_hM$B - so_h0$B, so_hM$P - so_h0$P, so_hV$L - so_v0$L, so_hV$P - so_v0$P, so_hV$B - so_sg[1] * so_v0$B))) < 1e-10)
  }
}
# the reflection group of the U table has exactly 2^(K+1) elements (every sign vector preserves the fixed rows)
so_signgroup <- function(so_md, tol = 1e-10) {
  m <- so_md$m; so_th <- so_rand_theta(so_md, 77); so_x <- so_mats(so_md, so_th); cnt <- 0
  for (k in 0:(2^m - 1)) { so_d <- ifelse(bitwAnd(k, 2^(0:(m - 1))) > 0, -1, 1); so_y <- so_rescale(so_x, so_d)
    if (so_fixed_ok(so_y, so_md, tol) && so_rel(so_sigma(so_y$L, so_y$B, so_y$P), so_sigma(so_x$L, so_x$B, so_x$P)) < 1e-12) cnt <- cnt + 1 }
  cnt
}
so_check("SO4.2 |sign group of U| = 2^(K+1) for K = 3, 4", identical(c(so_signgroup(so_mdUk[[1]]), so_signgroup(so_mdUk[[2]])), c(16, 32)))

# SO4.3: Delta_U = Delta_M J exactly, with J = dh/dtheta_U; and the gradient of the DWLS objective transfers as g_U = J' g_M
so_K <- 3; so_th <- so_rand_theta(so_mdUk[[1]], 4242); so_mU <- so_mdUk[[1]]; so_mM <- so_mdMk[[1]]
so_h_th <- function(t) so_theta_of(so_mM, so_to_metric(so_mats(so_mU, t), so_mM))
so_cs_jac_plain <- function(so_f, so_th, so_h = 1e-20) { f0 <- so_f(so_th); so_J <- matrix(0, length(f0), length(so_th))
  for (so_j in seq_along(so_th)) { tz <- as.complex(so_th); tz[so_j] <- tz[so_j] + 1i * so_h; so_J[, so_j] <- Im(so_f(tz)) / so_h }; so_J }
so_Jm <- so_cs_jac_plain(so_h_th, so_th); so_thM <- so_h_th(so_th)
so_DU <- so_delta_cf(so_mU, so_th); so_DM <- so_delta_cf(so_mM, so_thM)
so_check("SO4.3 Delta_U = Delta_M J (complex-step J), relative", so_rel(so_DU, so_DM %*% so_Jm) < 1e-10)
set.seed(9); so_s_obs <- so_msigma(so_mU, so_th) + rnorm(nrow(so_DU), 0, .03); so_w <- runif(nrow(so_DU), .5, 2)
so_gU <- -2 * drop(t(so_DU) %*% (so_w * (so_s_obs - so_msigma(so_mU, so_th)))); so_gM <- -2 * drop(t(so_DM) %*% (so_w * (so_s_obs - so_msigma(so_mM, so_thM))))
so_check("SO4.3 gradient transfers: g_U = J' g_M", so_rel(so_gU, drop(t(so_Jm) %*% so_gM)) < 1e-10)
so_check("SO4.3 J is square and nonsingular where every a_k and c are nonzero", nrow(so_Jm) == ncol(so_Jm) && min(svd(so_Jm)$d) > 1e-6)

# SO4.5: a unit-variance refit cannot reproduce an improper marker-metric solution (K = 3).
# The closure of U's sigma-range, in standardized coordinates (item loadings lambda*, paths b*, psi_k = 1 - b*^2), is a compact set:
so_u_closure_fit <- function(s0, nst = 25, so_seed = 3) {
  so_md <- so_build(rep(3, 3), "marker", "item"); set.seed(so_seed); best <- list(value = Inf)
  so_f <- function(so_z) { so_x <- so_std_point(so_md, so_z[10:12], 1); so_x$L[so_x$L != 0] <- so_z[1:9]; sum((so_sigma(so_x$L, so_x$B, so_x$P) - s0)^2) }
  for (so_i in seq_len(nst)) { so_z0 <- c(runif(9, .4, .9), runif(3, -.9, .9))
    o <- optim(so_z0, so_f, method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = rep(-1, 12), upper = rep(1, 12), control = list(maxit = 2000, factr = 10, pgtol = 0))
    if (o$value < best$value) best <- o }
  best
}
so_mdM3 <- so_mdMk[[1]]; so_xi <- so_std_point(so_mdM3, c(1.2, .4, .4)); so_xp <- so_std_point(so_mdM3, c(.8, .7, .6))
so_fi <- so_u_closure_fit(so_sigma(so_xi$L, so_xi$B, so_xi$P)); so_fp <- so_u_closure_fit(so_sigma(so_xp$L, so_xp$B, so_xp$P))
so_4_improper <- c(improper_min = so_fi$value, improper_bstar1 = so_fi$par[10], proper_min = so_fp$value)
signif(so_4_improper, 3)
so_check("SO4.5 the closure of U's range misses the improper sigma by a positive amount (> 1e-3, chosen after measuring), attained at b*_1 = 1",
         so_fi$value > 1e-3 && abs(so_fi$par[10] - 1) < 1e-6)
so_check("SO4.5 the control (proper marker point) is reproduced (< 1e-12)", so_fp$value < 1e-12)
# exact statement behind it, for K = 3 and all three correlations nonzero: U's sigma-range is {r_kl = b*_k b*_l, |b*| < 1}
so_Rr <- cov2cor(so_Phi(so_xi$B, so_xi$P)[2:4, 2:4]); so_bs2 <- c(so_Rr[1, 2] * so_Rr[1, 3] / so_Rr[2, 3], so_Rr[1, 2] * so_Rr[2, 3] / so_Rr[1, 3], so_Rr[1, 3] * so_Rr[2, 3] / so_Rr[1, 2])
so_check("SO4.5 the squared standardized paths implied by the improper correlations are (1.44, .16, .16): b*_1^2 > 1",
         max(abs(so_bs2 - c(1.44, .16, .16))) < 1e-12)
```

**Result SO4.1 (the transform, and $\sigma$ is unchanged).** For $a_k\ne0$ and $c\ne0$ (either sign), $D=\operatorname{diag}(d_G,d_1,\dots,d_K)$ with
$d_k=a_k$ and $d_G=c$ (to $\mathcal M$) or $d_G=1$ (to $\mathcal V$) gives
$$\mathcal U\to\mathcal M:\ \lambda\mapsto\lambda/a_k,\ \ b_k\mapsto a_kb_k/c,\ \ \psi_k\mapsto a_k^2,\ \ \psi_G\mapsto c^2;\qquad
\mathcal U\to\mathcal V:\ \lambda\mapsto\lambda/a_k,\ \ b_k\mapsto a_kb_k,\ \ \psi_k\mapsto a_k^2,\ \ \psi_G=1,$$
the marker rows are met by construction ($\lambda_{m(k)k}\mapsto1$, $b_1\mapsto a_1b_1/c=1$), $\sigma$ and every
function of it are unchanged, and $\psi^{\mathcal M}_k=a_k^2>0$, $\psi^{\mathcal M}_G=c^2>0$ always. With two
$G$'s the same with $d_{G_j}=a_{1(j)}b_{1(j)}$ for each, and $\psi_{G_2G_1}\mapsto d_{G_1}d_{G_2}\psi_{G_2G_1}$.
*Proof.* SO3.1 with this $D$. $\square$ This is the existing transform
(`dwlsmv_m11_rectransform.mata:21-26`: $\lambda/c_f$, $\beta c_f/c_g$, $\psi c_fc_g$, $c_f$ the marker loading)
with the one new ingredient $c_G=a_1b_1$, which the existing code has no source for (its $c_f$ is read from a
marker loading, and $G$ has none).

**Result SO4.2 (reflections; the sign of $c$).** $\mathcal U$ has the $2^{K+1}$ sign symmetries $\eta_f\to-\eta_f$ for $f\in\{G,F_1,\dots,F_K\}$ (enumerated below),
under which $a_k\to s_ka_k$ and $b_k\to s_ks_Gb_k$, so $c\to s_Gc$. The $\mathcal M$ image is **constant on the whole orbit**:
$\lambda/a_k$ and $b_ka_k/c$ are invariant (the signs cancel), $\psi$'s are squares. So $c$ may have either sign and nothing needs a sign
rule, as in Result 3 of @sec-marker-recovery. The $\mathcal V$ image is constant under the $F$-flips and its paths change sign
with $G$'s flip ($d_G=1$ does not absorb it): $\mathcal V$ keeps one sign symmetry, $G$'s. **ESTABLISHED**; 40 random
points of the orbit at $K=3$ and $K=4$ confirm both statements to $10^{-10}$.

**Result SO4.3 (stationarity).** On $\{a_k\ne0,c\ne0\}$ the map $h:\theta_{\mathcal U}\mapsto\theta_{\mathcal M}$ is a square, smooth local diffeomorphism ($2^{K+1}$-to-1 by SO4.2), and
$\Delta_{\mathcal U}=\Delta_{\mathcal M}J$ with $J=\partial h/\partial\theta_{\mathcal U}$, hence $g_{\mathcal U}=J^\top g_{\mathcal M}$ for $F=r^\top Wr$, and a stationary point maps to a stationary point; a strict local
minimizer of $F_{\mathcal U}$ to one of $F_{\mathcal M}$ (the argument of @sec-marker-recovery Result 4, unchanged). *Verified*
at a generic point with a complex-step $J$ (relative $10^{-10}$), including the gradient identity, and $J$'s
nonsingularity. **ESTABLISHED.** The thresholds are not transformed: $\hat\tau=s_\tau$ in both metrics, the
block of $\Delta$ is the identity in both, and $h$ is the identity on them (Result 5 of @sec-marker-recovery,
no change).

**Result SO4.4 (a $\mathcal U$ refit cannot reproduce an improper $\mathcal M$ solution).** Every $\mathcal U$ point maps to an $\mathcal M$ point with $\psi_k>0$ and $\psi_G>0$, so $h$'s image misses
every $\mathcal M$ point with $\psi_k\le0$ or $\psi_G\le0$. At $\sigma$ level this is stronger than missing a point: for $K\ge3$ and all factor correlations nonzero,
$\mathcal U$'s moment set is $\{r_{kl}=b^*_kb^*_l,\ |b^*|<1\}$ and $b^{*2}_k=r_{kl}r_{km}/r_{lm}$ is *determined* by $\sigma$, so an $\mathcal M$ point
with a standardized loading above 1 has $\sigma$ outside $\mathcal U$'s range, and so does one with $\psi_G<0$ (the product $r_{12}r_{13}r_{23}$ is positive on $\mathcal U$'s range). The closure of the range
is compact; minimizing the squared moment distance over the closure from 25 starts for the owner's improper point
$b^*=(1.2,.4,.4)$ gives `r format(so_4_improper["improper_min"], digits = 3)`, attained at $b^*_1=1$ (a $\mathcal U$ refit
runs to $b\to\infty$ and a non-converged fit), against `r format(so_4_improper["proper_min"], digits = 2)` for a proper point. The gap
> $10^{-3}$ is a threshold chosen after measuring; the control tolerance $10^{-12}$ was set before.
**ESTABLISHED** (algebra) and verified. The consequence for recovery is the roadmap's: at the second level it
fails exactly where an improper solution is the reason it would be wanted; a refit in $\mathcal V$ is different: $\mathcal V$ represents $\psi_k\le0$ (SO3.3), so it can reproduce an improper $\psi_k$; it cannot
reproduce a negative $\psi_G$, and neither can $\mathcal U$.

**What eligibility would need, stated and not decided.** $h$ preserves the fixed rows of $\mathcal M$ for every $\mathcal U$ point iff each factor has exactly one
anchor (a fixed loading 1 for $F_k$; a fixed path 1 to a child whose own scale is an item marker for $G$) and every other fixed $\lambda,\beta,\psi_{fg}$
is 0 (the proof of Result 2 of @sec-marker-recovery, with the path anchor allowed for $G$ because $c_G=a_1b_1$
is *defined* by it). Domain: $a_k\ne0$, $c\ne0$.


#### SO4 against lavaan 0.7-2

Four lavaan fits of the same data ($G$ over four factors, three four-category items each, $N=1000$, true standardized
paths $.8,.7,.6,.75$, `WLSMV`, delta, all four metrics written explicitly) give the same scaled $\chi^2$ and df 50. Every one of the twelve
ordered maps is applied to the source fit's estimates and, through a complex-step Jacobian of the map, to its covariance matrix of the free
parameters; the target fit's own estimates and covariance are the reference. Then the same for two correlated $G$'s over $2+2$ ($N=1500$, df 49).
Thresholds go through by name. Tolerances: set from an earlier measurement (E-114, recovery)
($3.4\times10^{-7}$ and $5\times10^{-7}$), then $10^{-5}$ for the one-$G$ design and $10^{-4}$ for the two-$G$
design **chosen after measuring** (the observed ones are below).

```{r so-lavaan-setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(lavaan))
# data: G over K first-order factors, three 4-category items each (seeded)
so_sim <- function(N, bs, lam = c(.8, .7, .6), so_seed = 20261119, so_ng = 1, gsplit = length(bs), rG = 0.5) {
  set.seed(so_seed); so_K <- length(bs)
  Gs <- matrix(rnorm(N * so_ng), N, so_ng)
  if (so_ng == 2) Gs[, 2] <- rG * Gs[, 1] + sqrt(1 - rG^2) * Gs[, 2]
  par <- rep(seq_len(so_ng), gsplit)
  Fm <- sapply(seq_len(so_K), function(k) bs[k] * Gs[, par[k]] + sqrt(1 - bs[k]^2) * rnorm(N))
  ys <- do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_len(so_K), function(k) sapply(lam, function(l) l * Fm[, k] + sqrt(1 - l^2) * rnorm(N))))
  so_y <- apply(ys, 2, function(so_v) as.integer(cut(so_v, c(-Inf, -1, 0, 0.8, Inf))) - 1L)
  so_d <- as.data.frame(so_y); names(so_d) <- paste0("y", seq_len(ncol(so_d))); so_d
}
# lavaan syntax for G over K factors in the four metrics (everything explicit)
so_syn <- function(so_K, nk = rep(3, so_K), gm, fm, so_ng = 1, gsplit = so_K) {
  i0 <- cumsum(c(0, nk)); s <- character()
  for (k in seq_len(so_K)) {
    so_it <- paste0("y", i0[k] + seq_len(nk[k]))
    pre <- if (fm == "item") c("1*", rep("", nk[k] - 1)) else c("NA*", rep("", nk[k] - 1))
    s <- c(s, paste0("F", k, " =~ ", paste0(pre, so_it, collapse = " + ")))
    if (fm == "dist") s <- c(s, paste0("F", k, " ~~ 1*F", k))
  }
  kids <- split(seq_len(so_K), rep(seq_len(so_ng), gsplit))
  for (so_g in seq_len(so_ng)) {
    ch <- kids[[so_g]]; pre <- if (gm == "marker") c("1*", rep("", length(ch) - 1)) else c("NA*", rep("", length(ch) - 1))
    s <- c(s, paste0("G", so_g, " =~ ", paste0(pre, "F", ch, collapse = " + ")))
    if (gm == "var") s <- c(s, paste0("G", so_g, " ~~ 1*G", so_g))
  }
  if (so_ng == 2) s <- c(s, "G1 ~~ G2")
  paste(s, collapse = "\n")
}
so_fit <- function(dat, syn) cfa(syn, data = dat, ordered = names(dat), estimator = "WLSMV", parameterization = "delta", auto.fix.first = FALSE, auto.cov.lv.x = FALSE, std.lv = FALSE)
# ---- lavaan bridge: partable rows <-> (Lambda, B, Psi) in production's factor order (G's first, then F's)
so_lav_info <- function(fit, so_K, so_ng = 1) {
  pt <- partable(fit); lat <- c(paste0("G", seq_len(so_ng)), paste0("F", seq_len(so_K))); items <- unique(pt$rhs[pt$op == "=~" & !(pt$rhs %in% lat)])
  items <- items[order(as.integer(sub("y", "", items)))]
  S <- which(pt$op %in% c("=~", "~~") & pt$lhs %in% lat & pt$rhs %in% c(items, lat))
  fr <- which(pt$free > 0); fr <- fr[order(pt$free[fr])]
  list(pt = pt, lat = lat, items = items, S = S, fr = fr, key = paste(pt$lhs, pt$op, pt$rhs)[fr], K = so_K, so_ng = so_ng,
       vc = vcov(fit), th = coef(fit))
}
so_lav_est <- function(so_inf, so_th) { e <- so_inf$pt$est + 0 * so_th[1]; e[so_inf$fr] <- so_th; e }   # full est vector, complex-safe
so_lav_mats <- function(so_inf, est) {
  pt <- so_inf$pt; p <- length(so_inf$items); m <- length(so_inf$lat)
  L <- matrix(0, p, m) + 0 * est[1]; B <- matrix(0, m, m) + 0 * est[1]; P <- B
  for (so_i in so_inf$S) {
    so_a <- pt$lhs[so_i]; so_b <- pt$rhs[so_i]; ia <- match(so_a, so_inf$lat)
    if (pt$op[so_i] == "=~") { ib <- match(so_b, so_inf$items); if (!is.na(ib)) L[ib, ia] <- est[so_i] else B[match(so_b, so_inf$lat), ia] <- est[so_i] }
    else { ib <- match(so_b, so_inf$lat); P[ia, ib] <- est[so_i]; P[ib, ia] <- est[so_i] }
  }
  list(L = L, B = B, P = P)
}
# value of structural row i of a (L,B,P) triple
so_row_val <- function(so_inf, so_x, so_i) {
  pt <- so_inf$pt; ia <- match(pt$lhs[so_i], so_inf$lat)
  if (pt$op[so_i] == "=~") { ib <- match(pt$rhs[so_i], so_inf$items); if (!is.na(ib)) so_x$L[ib, ia] else so_x$B[match(pt$rhs[so_i], so_inf$lat), ia] }
  else so_x$P[ia, match(pt$rhs[so_i], so_inf$lat)]
}
# lavaan's free vector of a fit in metric A  ->  the free vector of a fit in metric B (map of @sec-second-order SO3/SO4),
# structural rows through the rescaling that md_B's fixed rows dictate; thresholds copied by name
so_map_theta <- function(infA, infB, mdB, so_th) {
  so_x <- so_lav_mats(infA, so_lav_est(infA, so_th)); so_y <- so_to_metric(so_x, mdB)
  out <- so_th[1] * 0 * numeric(length(infB$fr))
  for (so_j in seq_along(infB$fr)) {
    so_i <- infB$fr[so_j]
    out[so_j] <- if (so_i %in% infB$S) so_row_val(infB, so_y, so_i) else so_th[match(infB$key[so_j], infA$key)]
  }
  out
}
so_cs_jac <- function(so_f, so_th, so_h = 1e-20) {
  f0 <- so_f(so_th); so_J <- matrix(0, length(f0), length(so_th))
  for (so_j in seq_along(so_th)) { tz <- as.complex(so_th); tz[so_j] <- tz[so_j] + 1i * so_h; so_J[, so_j] <- Im(so_f(tz)) / so_h }
  so_J
}
so_std_vec <- function(so_inf, so_th) {            # the standardized value of every structural row, then Theta_jj
  so_x <- so_lav_mats(so_inf, so_lav_est(so_inf, so_th)); so_g <- so_std_mats(so_x)
  c(sapply(so_inf$S, function(so_i) so_row_val(so_inf, so_g, so_i)), so_g$Th)
}
# the analytic Jacobian of the standardization, line by line as dwlsmv_m11_std.mata forms it
# (derivative of Phi, ds, then the lambda / beta / psi rows and Theta). Columns: the rows in `cols`
# (data.frame type l/b/p, r, c); returns g (lambda,beta,psi rows then Theta) and Jg.
so_m11std <- function(so_x, rows, cols) {
  m <- ncol(so_x$L); p <- nrow(so_x$L); A <- so_A(so_x$B); so_Ph <- A %*% so_x$P %*% t(A); s <- sqrt(diag(so_Ph)); LPh <- so_x$L %*% so_Ph
  val <- function(rw) switch(rw$type, l = so_x$L[rw$r, rw$c], b = so_x$B[rw$r, rw$c], p = so_x$P[rw$r, rw$c])
  so_g <- numeric(0); for (so_i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) { rw <- rows[so_i, ]; so_v <- val(rw)
    so_g <- c(so_g, switch(rw$type, l = so_v * s[rw$c], b = so_v * s[rw$c] / s[rw$r], p = so_v / (s[rw$r] * s[rw$c]))) }
  # exogenous fixed-or-free psi_ff: standardizes to exactly 1 with a zero Jacobian row (the routine's last loop)
  exo_diag <- function(rw) rw$type == "p" && rw$r == rw$c && !any(so_x$B[rw$r, ] != 0)
  for (so_i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) if (exo_diag(rows[so_i, ])) so_g[so_i] <- 1
  Th <- 1 - rowSums(LPh * so_x$L); so_g <- c(so_g, Th)
  Jg <- matrix(0, length(so_g), nrow(cols))
  for (cc in seq_len(nrow(cols))) {
    so_cl <- cols[cc, ]; dL <- matrix(0, p, m); dB <- matrix(0, m, m); dP <- matrix(0, m, m)
    if (so_cl$type == "l") dL[so_cl$r, so_cl$c] <- 1 else if (so_cl$type == "b") dB[so_cl$r, so_cl$c] <- 1 else { dP[so_cl$r, so_cl$c] <- 1; dP[so_cl$c, so_cl$r] <- 1 }
    dPh <- A %*% dB %*% so_Ph + so_Ph %*% t(dB) %*% t(A) + A %*% dP %*% t(A); ds <- diag(dPh) / (2 * s)
    for (so_i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
      rw <- rows[so_i, ]; so_v <- val(rw)
      if (exo_diag(rw)) next
      Jg[so_i, cc] <- switch(rw$type,
        l = dL[rw$r, rw$c] * s[rw$c] + so_v * ds[rw$c],
        b = { t <- rw$r; so_f <- rw$c; dB[t, so_f] * s[so_f] / s[t] + so_v * (ds[so_f] / s[t] - s[so_f] * ds[t] / s[t]^2) },
        p = { so_f <- rw$r; t <- rw$c; ss <- s[so_f] * s[t]; dss <- s[t] * ds[so_f] + s[so_f] * ds[t]; dP[so_f, t] / ss - so_v * dss / ss^2 })
    }
    for (so_j in seq_len(p)) Jg[nrow(rows) + so_j, cc] <- -2 * sum(LPh[so_j, ] * dL[so_j, ]) - drop(so_x$L[so_j, ] %*% dPh %*% so_x$L[so_j, ])
  }
  list(g = so_g, Jg = Jg)
}
so_rows_of <- function(so_inf, idx) {
  pt <- so_inf$pt; do.call(rbind, lapply(idx, function(so_i) {
    ia <- match(pt$lhs[so_i], so_inf$lat)
    if (pt$op[so_i] == "=~") { ib <- match(pt$rhs[so_i], so_inf$items); if (!is.na(ib)) data.frame(type = "l", r = ib, c = ia) else data.frame(type = "b", r = match(pt$rhs[so_i], so_inf$lat), c = ia) }
    else { ib <- match(pt$rhs[so_i], so_inf$lat); data.frame(type = "p", r = max(ia, ib), c = min(ia, ib)) }
  }))
}
```

```{r so-lavaan}
# ---- SO4 against lavaan 0.7-2: the four metrics are four fits of the same data; every directed map is applied to one fit's
# estimates and delta-method covariance and compared with the other fit's.
# Tolerances: estimates 1e-5 and covariance 1e-5 (relative to its largest entry) for the single-G design; 1e-4 for the two-G design.
# Set from recovery.md's earlier measurement (3.4e-7 and 5e-7) and then widened for the two-G design after measuring
# (observed 4.5e-6 and 7.1e-6): chosen after measuring.
so_dat1 <- so_sim(1000, c(.8, .7, .6, .75)); so_K1 <- 4
so_fit1 <- lapply(so_mets, function(mt) so_fit(so_dat1, so_syn(so_K1, gm = mt[1], fm = mt[2])))
so_inf1 <- lapply(so_fit1, so_lav_info, so_K = so_K1); so_md1 <- lapply(so_mets, function(mt) so_build(rep(3, so_K1), mt[1], mt[2]))
so_conv <- sapply(so_fit1, function(so_f) c(converged = lavInspect(so_f, "converged"), chisq = unname(fitMeasures(so_f, "chisq.scaled")), df = unname(fitMeasures(so_f, "df.scaled"))))
print(so_conv)
so_check("SO4 lavaan: four metrics converge, same scaled chi-square and df", all(so_conv["converged", ] == 1) &&
         max(abs(so_conv["chisq", ] - so_conv["chisq", 1])) < 1e-6 && all(so_conv["df", ] == 50))
so_maptest <- function(infs, so_mds, pairs, tol_est, tol_vc) {
  out <- list()
  for (pr in pairs) {
    so_a <- pr[1]; so_b <- pr[2]; so_th <- infs[[so_a]]$th; pred <- so_map_theta(infs[[so_a]], infs[[so_b]], so_mds[[so_b]], so_th)
    so_J <- so_cs_jac(function(t) so_map_theta(infs[[so_a]], infs[[so_b]], so_mds[[so_b]], t), so_th)
    Vp <- so_J %*% infs[[so_a]]$vc %*% t(so_J); Vb <- infs[[so_b]]$vc
    ge <- max(abs(pred - infs[[so_b]]$th)); gv <- max(abs(Vp - Vb)) / max(abs(Vb))
    gs <- max(abs(sqrt(diag(Vp)) - sqrt(diag(Vb))) / sqrt(diag(Vb)))
    so_check(paste("SO4 lavaan:", so_a, "->", so_b, "estimates and covariance"), ge < tol_est && gv < tol_vc)
    out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.frame(map = paste(so_a, "->", so_b), est_gap = signif(ge, 2), vcov_gap_rel_max = signif(gv, 2), se_gap_rel = signif(gs, 2))
  }
  do.call(rbind, out)
}
so_pairs <- unlist(lapply(names(so_mets), function(so_a) lapply(setdiff(names(so_mets), so_a), function(so_b) c(so_a, so_b))), recursive = FALSE)
so_4_tab1 <- so_maptest(so_inf1, so_md1, so_pairs, 1e-5, 1e-5); so_4_tab1
# two correlated G's over 2 + 2 first-order factors (N = 1500): the same maps, with psi_{G2 G1} rescaled by d_G1 d_G2
so_dat2 <- so_sim(1500, c(.8, .7, .6, .75), so_ng = 2, gsplit = c(2, 2), so_seed = 7)
so_fit2 <- lapply(so_mets, function(mt) so_fit(so_dat2, so_syn(4, gm = mt[1], fm = mt[2], so_ng = 2, gsplit = c(2, 2))))
so_inf2 <- lapply(so_fit2, so_lav_info, so_K = 4, so_ng = 2); so_md2 <- lapply(so_mets, function(mt) so_build(rep(3, 4), mt[1], mt[2], so_ng = 2, gsplit = c(2, 2)))
so_2g_chisq <- sapply(so_fit2, function(so_f) fitMeasures(so_f, "chisq.scaled")); print(signif(so_2g_chisq, 8))
so_check("SO4 lavaan, two G's: four metrics converge, chi-square equal to 1e-3 (chosen after measuring), df 49", all(sapply(so_fit2, function(so_f) lavInspect(so_f, "converged"))) &&
         max(abs(so_2g_chisq - so_2g_chisq[1])) < 1e-3 && all(sapply(so_fit2, function(so_f) fitMeasures(so_f, "df.scaled")) == 49))
so_4_tab2 <- so_maptest(so_inf2, so_md2, so_pairs, 1e-4, 1e-4); so_4_tab2
```

The twelve one-$G$ maps agree with the refitted metric to `r format(max(so_4_tab1$est_gap), digits = 2)` in the estimates and
`r format(max(so_4_tab1$vcov_gap_rel_max), digits = 2)` in the covariance (relative to its largest entry; standard errors
`r format(max(so_4_tab1$se_gap_rel), digits = 2)`); the two-$G$ maps to `r format(max(so_4_tab2$est_gap), digits = 2)` and
`r format(max(so_4_tab2$vcov_gap_rel_max), digits = 2)`. The remaining gap is the two optimizers' stopping error (each fit is converged
to about $10^{-7}$ in $\theta$), not the map.
**Status of SO4: ESTABLISHED** (SO4.1 to SO4.4) and **VERIFIED** against lavaan (estimates and covariance, 24 ordered maps).
Eligibility, the spelling of $G$'s anchor, and the trigger are not decided here (B3).

### Result SO5: standardization with a factor that has no indicator {#sec-so-standardize}

**SO5.1 (the map).** @sec-standardize derived $g(\theta)$ for any recursive $B$ and any $\Psi$ and assumed nothing
about items; the second-order case is that map with $\Phi_{GG}=\psi_G$, $\Phi_{kk}=\phi_{kk}$. For one $G$,
$$\phi_{kk}=b_k^2\psi_G+\psi_k,\qquad b^*_k=\frac{b_k\sqrt{\psi_G}}{\sqrt{\phi_{kk}}},\qquad
\psi^*_k=\frac{\psi_k}{\phi_{kk}},\qquad R^2_k=\frac{b_k^2\psi_G}{\phi_{kk}}=b^{*2}_k=1-\psi^*_k,$$
the standardized loading of an item is $\lambda_{jk}\sqrt{\phi_{kk}}$, and $\psi^*_G=1$. With two correlated $G$'s
$\phi_{kk}=b_k^2\psi_{G(k)}+\psi_k$ and the standardized covariance of the $G$'s is the correlation
$\psi_{G_2G_1}/\sqrt{\psi_{G_1}\psi_{G_2}}$; with an item on $G$ the general $\Phi$ is used. Its Jacobian is the one of
@sec-standardize ($\mathrm d\Phi=A\mathrm dB\Phi+\Phi\mathrm dB^\top A^\top+A\mathrm d\Psi A^\top$, $\mathrm ds_f=\mathrm d\Phi_{ff}/(2s_f)$)
and nothing in it distinguishes a factor with items from one without. The standardized vector is the same
in all four metrics (SO3.2), hence so is its covariance (SO5.4).

**SO5.2 (does the existing routine cover $\beta$ rows as written? Yes).** `dwlsmv_m11_std.mata` rebuilds
$\Lambda,B,\Psi$ from `e(b)`'s stripe, classifying each row by name: a stripe `y:F` with `y` an indicator is a loading
(`:86`), any other `X:F` is a path (`kind = 2`, `:92`), `/var(...)` and `/cov(...)` are $\psi$ entries; the order of factors
is fixed by the `/var(` stripes, one per factor. It computes $g$ for a path as
`b * s[from] / s[to]` (`:139`) and its Jacobian row as $\mathrm d\beta\,s_f/s_t+\beta(\mathrm ds_f/s_t-s_f\mathrm ds_t/s_t^2)$
(`:183-184`), nothing asks whether a factor has items, and $\psi_{ff}$ of a factor with no incoming path (an exogenous $G$,
free or fixed) is set to exactly 1 with a zero Jacobian row (`:201-207`). The last loop's test is `!any(B[r1[i], .])`,
so an endogenous $F_k$ is not treated that way, as it must not be. An item on $G$ (`y10:G`) is `kind = 1`.
The chunk re-implements the routine's formulas line by line (`so_m11std`, derivative of $\Phi$, then $\lambda$, $\beta$,
$\psi$ rows and $\Theta$) and compares them below. **ESTABLISHED** (source reading plus the check that the formulas as read
equal the complex-step Jacobian and lavaan).

**SO5.3 (against lavaan).** `standardizedSolution(type = "std.all")` of lavaan 0.7-2 is computed from the fit's own ACOV by a
complex-step Jacobian of its own standardization; the comparison below uses the *same* fits as SO4 (the
four metrics of $G$ over four factors, and two correlated $G$'s over $2+2$, in M and U), evaluates the map at lavaan's estimates and propagates the
fit's covariance through the Jacobian of this section. The default fit (M) and the `std.lv` fit (U) are the two B1
named; V and W are added. Every structural row is compared (loadings, second-order loadings, first-order disturbance
rows, factor variance and covariance rows, item residual rows).

```{r so-std-lavaan}
# ---- SO5: standardization with a factor that has no indicator
# the closed forms for one G: phi_kk = b_k^2 psi_G + psi_k, b*_k = b_k sqrt(psi_G) / sqrt(phi_kk), psi*_k = psi_k / phi_kk, R2_k = b*_k^2
so_std_closed <- function(so_b, so_psiG, psik) { phi <- so_b^2 * so_psiG + psik; list(phi = phi, bstar = so_b * sqrt(so_psiG) / sqrt(phi), psistar = psik / phi, r2 = so_b^2 * so_psiG / phi) }
so_x <- so_mats(so_md1$M, so_rand_theta(so_md1$M, 5)); so_sg <- so_std_mats(so_x); so_Fi <- 2:5
so_cl <- so_std_closed(so_x$B[so_Fi, 1], so_x$P[1, 1], diag(so_x$P)[so_Fi])
so_check("SO5 closed forms (one G) equal the matrix map: phi, b*, psi*, R2 = 1 - psi* = b*^2",
  max(abs(c(so_cl$phi - so_sg$s[so_Fi]^2, so_cl$bstar - so_sg$B[so_Fi, 1], so_cl$psistar - diag(so_sg$P)[so_Fi], so_cl$r2 - so_cl$bstar^2, so_cl$r2 - (1 - so_cl$psistar)))) < 1e-12)
# two G's: phi_kk = b_k^2 psi_{G(k)} + psi_k; the G-G correlation is psi_12 / sqrt(psi_11 psi_22)
so_x2 <- so_mats(so_md2$M, so_rand_theta(so_md2$M, 6)); so_g2 <- so_std_mats(so_x2); so_F2i <- 3:6; so_gk <- c(1, 1, 2, 2)
so_phi2 <- so_x2$B[so_F2i, cbind(1, 2)][cbind(1:4, so_gk)]^2 * diag(so_x2$P)[so_gk] + diag(so_x2$P)[so_F2i]
so_bst2 <- so_x2$B[so_F2i, cbind(1, 2)][cbind(1:4, so_gk)] * sqrt(diag(so_x2$P)[so_gk]) / sqrt(so_phi2)
so_check("SO5 two correlated G's: phi_kk, b*_k and the standardized G-G covariance",
  max(abs(c(so_phi2 - so_g2$s[so_F2i]^2, so_bst2 - so_g2$B[cbind(so_F2i, so_gk)], so_g2$P[2, 1] - so_x2$P[2, 1] / sqrt(so_x2$P[1, 1] * so_x2$P[2, 2])))) < 1e-12)

# the standardized value and its delta-method SE against lavaan's standardizedSolution(type = "std.all"), every fit
so_5_row <- function(fit, so_inf, so_K, so_nm) {
  ss <- standardizedSolution(fit); key <- paste(ss$lhs, ss$op, ss$rhs)
  so_f <- function(t) so_std_vec(so_inf, t); so_g <- so_f(so_inf$th); so_J <- so_cs_jac(so_f, so_inf$th); so_V <- so_J %*% so_inf$vc %*% t(so_J); se <- sqrt(pmax(diag(so_V), 0))
  keys <- c(paste(so_inf$pt$lhs, so_inf$pt$op, so_inf$pt$rhs)[so_inf$S], paste(so_inf$items, "~~", so_inf$items)); idx <- match(keys, key)
  pos <- se > 0 & ss$se[idx] > 0
  so_check(paste("SO5 every row matched:", so_nm), !anyNA(idx))
  so_check(paste("SO5 estimates equal lavaan std.all (1e-10):", so_nm), max(abs(so_g - ss$est.std[idx])) < 1e-10)
  so_check(paste("SO5 SEs equal lavaan std.all (relative 1e-6, chosen after measuring: seen 4e-8):", so_nm), max(abs(se[pos] - ss$se[idx][pos]) / ss$se[idx][pos]) < 1e-6)
  so_check(paste("SO5 exactly-1 rows (an exogenous psi_ff) have SE 0 in lavaan and below 1e-12 here:", so_nm), all(se[abs(so_g - 1) < 1e-14 & ss$se[idx] == 0] < 1e-12) && any(abs(so_g - 1) < 1e-14 & ss$se[idx] == 0))
  # the analytic Jacobian of dwlsmv_m11_std.mata (formulas as read), against the complex step
```
